Ideal FamilyA peaceful, loving home would be perfect for Nusha. She loves walks and play, but thrives in calm environments, ideally with a friendly resident dog who can be her emotional support and playmate. She would suit adults or families with older, gentle children.

Nusha is pure tenderness — a gentle soul who wants nothing more than love, safety, and a doggy friend by her side.

Health InformationNusha is fully healthy. Spayed. Has all core vaccines done and is microchipped. All dogs are C.Brucella tested before the trip (owners will receive a licensed laboratory test certificate).

RBU, post-adoption support, and 4 weeks free PetPlan insurance provided upon adoption.

name: Lord
description:
Lord – The Wise Young Gentleman With a Noble Heart

Lord is a Ukraine war dog in need of a safe haven. Available under a foster-to-adopt. Expected arrival: 19 December.

Meet Lord – a 7-month-old lower-medium boy, expected to grow a little more, whose gentle dignity and natural intelligence make him stand out from the very first moment.

He may be young, but he carries himself with a calm, thoughtful presence that feels far beyond his age. A tender soul with a noble heart, Lord is ready to bring warmth, loyalty, and quiet wisdom into a family of his own.

He will be lower-medium in size (below the knee) when fully grown.

Rescue StoryLord and his two sisters, Nusha and Lisa, were found as tiny pups at summer houses settlement— alone, unwanted, and surviving only thanks to sheer luck and their bond with one another. Someone had left them behind, and like countless dogs in Ukraine, they slipped through the cracks of people’s lives. A volunteer discovered them just in time and brought them to safety, giving these three youngsters a chance to grow up surrounded by kindness instead of danger.

More About LordLord is, in every sense, a remarkable puppy. Despite his age, he carries himself with a gentle maturity — wise, calm, and incredibly easy to teach. He understands new commands instantly, observes before acting, and behaves at home like he’s already lived there for years.

His foster family says:“This is the perfect dog. Despite being so young, he is unbelievably wise and balanced. You can feel a childlike nobility in him. With the right family, he will grow into a true wonder-dog.”

He loves humans deeply, adores other dogs, and will thrive with a friendly canine buddy. Outdoors he enjoys playtime; indoors he is peaceful, polite and affectionate.

Ideal FamilyLord will thrive in a loving home that appreciates a sensitive, intelligent companion who learns fast and wants to please. He would enjoy an active lifestyle with people who value both playtime and calm companionship. Another friendly dog in the home would make him truly happy, giving him a steady companion and helping him settle faster. Gentle children 8+ would suit him well.

Lord is truly special — wise, loving, and beautifully gentle. Whoever adopts him will gain a devoted friend with a heart full of quiet loyalty.

Health InformationLord is fully healthy. Neutered. Has all core vaccines done and is microchipped. All dogs are C.Brucella tested before the trip (owners will receive a licensed laboratory test certificate).

RBU, post-adoption support, and 4 weeks free PetPlan insurance provided upon adoption.

name: Alaya
description:
Alaya – The Gentle Soul Who Believes in Love

Alaya is a Ukraine war dog in need of a safe haven. Available under a foster-to-adopt. Arrival in the UK expected 19 December.

Alaya is a beautiful upper-medium/large girl, around 4 years old. Her eyes tell a story of pain, hope, and endless loyalty. Despite all she has been through, Alaya remains one of those rare dogs whose faith in humans never broke.

Rescue StoryWhen the war tore through Ukraine, Alaya’s life was turned upside down. Her owner was called to the frontline and, desperate to keep her safe, placed her in temporary care. Sadly, the conditions were dreadful, she lived in a kennel near garages. When her rescuer reached out to help, she was found frightened and confused — someone had even used her for cruel “target practice” with an air gun.

About AlayaEven after everything, Alaya’s heart remains full of love. She’s gentle, quiet, and deeply affectionate — a dog who melts into cuddles and leans into her person with trust and longing. She can be little shy in a new environment, but once she feels safe, she shows her warm and loyal personality, following her person everywhere with gratitude in her eyes.

She is selective with dogs and prefers to be the only pet. Alaya is housetrained, polite indoors, and walks on a lead.

Ideal FamilyAlaya will thrive in a calm, loving home where she can finally exhale and enjoy peace. She’s best as an only dog and would suit a family or person with a gentle nature, perhaps with older children who understand that kindness and patience mean the world to her. A garden and quiet walks would make her happiest — she treasures the simple joys of life she once lost.

Alaya’s story is one of heartbreak turned into hope. Despite the cruelty she suffered, she still greets people with soft eyes and a wagging tail. Whoever opens their heart to her will gain an incredibly loyal, loving companion who will give back every ounce of kindness tenfold.

Health InformationAlaya is fully healthy. The pellets after shooting were later removed and healed. Spayed. Has all core vaccines done and is microchipped. C.Brucella tested before travel (owners will receive a licensed laboratory test certificate).

RBU, post-adoption support and 4 weeks free insurance provided upon adoption.

name: Nicol
description:
Nicol – A Heart Full of Love and a Fountain of Energy

Nicol is a Ukraine war dog in need of a safe haven. Available under a foster-to-adopt. Expected arrival 19 December.

Meet Nicol, a 2–3-year-old Labrador or cross girl, medium-to-upper-medium size. She’s a radiant, loving whirlwind of joy and energy — the kind of dog who fills a room with life and love just by walking into it. Trustful, affectionate, and endlessly playful, Nicol is pure sunshine in motion.

HighlightsSIZE: Medium/upper-medium (53–55 cm shoulder height / 20 kg)SPAYED: YesCHARACTER HIGHLIGHTS: Loving • Playful • High-energy • Smart • LoyalDOGS: Friendly but can be too pushy for calm or older dogs, better suits as the only dog or with young playful large maleCATS: Not testedCHILDREN: Best with confident, gentle children 10+ due to her lively energy

Rescue StorySome stories leave even the strongest hearts trembling — and Nicol’s is one of them.One day, a man appeared at the gates of a small shelter, holding Nicol on a piece of rope. He asked them to take her in, but the shelter was already full — there was simply no space. When told no, he turned away in frustration and headed towards the railway tracks, muttering that he would throw her under a train.

The volunteers ran after him and managed to save her just in time. From that moment on, Nicol became one of the most affectionate dogs they’ve ever known, as if she understood that kindness had just given her another chance at life.

Since then, Nicol has lived in foster care, and her gratitude shines in everything she does — in her wagging tail, her warm hugs, and her endless eagerness to please.

More About NicolNicol is a volcano of joy — a dog who greets every day as if it’s the best one ever. She adores her humans, seeking affection, hugs, and kisses. She’s incredibly smart and quick to learn, especially when treats and praise are involved.

Playtime is her favourite part of the day — she loves running, chasing toys, and wrestling playfully with other dogs. However, her enthusiasm can be a bit much for calmer or older dogs, so she would thrive either as the only dog in the home (with plenty of doggy playdates) or with a confident, playful male dog who matches her energy.

She lives in a home environment, is fully housetrained, and walks well on the lead, though can sometimes pull of excitement. Nicol’s joy, warmth, and love for people make her a truly special soul — one who deserves the best life after all she’s been through.

Ideal FamilyNicol would be perfect for an active family or individual who enjoys adventures, outdoor walks, and laughter-filled days. A secure garden is a must, as she loves to run and play. She’ll thrive in a home where someone is around most of the time and where her affectionate, energetic personality is embraced and celebrated.

Nicol was nearly lost forever, but kindness gave her a second chance. Now she’s ready to give all her love — and she has plenty of it to give. If you’re looking for a loyal, joyful, and deeply affectionate companion who will fill your life with laughter, hugs, and devotion, Nicol is waiting with open paws.

Health InformationNicol is fully healthy. Spayed, vaccinated, and microchipped.All dogs are C.Brucella tested before travel (owners receive a licensed laboratory test certificate).

RBU, post-adoption support, and 4 weeks free PetPlan insurance provided upon adoption.

name: Ben
description:
Ben is a 5-year-old male Cross-Breed. He comes across as a gentle giant, weighing around 35kg, yet he’s surprisingly easy to handle on the lead.

Ben has a reputation for being exceptional with his human family, and he mixes well with other dogs while even tolerating cats with calm patience.

Ben is a much-loved dog who previously lived on the square in North Macedonia, where he was cared for by the local community.

His life changed when new business owners moved in and no longer wanted him around, leading to his rescue and placement in foster care. Despite the upheaval, his affectionate nature has remained unwavering.

Ben’s foster carer speaks incredibly highly of him, describing him as loving, house-trained, and always eager for a good walk. He has settled well into life in the UK, showing the same charm and warmth that made him popular back home.

Anyone welcoming him into their home would be gaining a loyal, sweet-natured companion.

name: Hooch
description:
Hooch is a 1-year-old male Belgian Malinois with a huge heart and an even bigger love for fun.

When he first arrived, Hooch was a little unsure around new people, but it didn’t take long for his true personality to shine through.

He’s an affectionate, friendly boy who loves making new friends—especially if his favourite toy is part of the introduction!

As a typical Belgian Malinois, Hooch is a high-energy dog who will thrive in an active home. He’ll need plenty of exercise and mental stimulation both indoors and outdoors. Activities like agility, scentwork/trailing, or flyball would suit him perfectly.

Hooch can live with older children and could potentially live with another dog following multiple successful meets. He has previously lived with another dog with no issues.

This playful lad adores his toys—fetch is his absolute favourite—so a good supply of toys is a must for his new home!

Hooch is currently struggling in kennels and really deserves to find his forever home soon. If you’re looking for a loyal, fun-loving, and affectionate best friend, please apply below to meet Hooch. He’s ready to brighten someone’s life.

Once we have received your application this will be reviewed by our dog team and if you are a suitable match one of our volunteers will be in touch within 7 days to discuss your application in more detail.

You will then be invited to meet the dog, and we encourage 2-3 meet & greets for you to get to know your chosen dog, we are happy to introduce you to multiple dogs on the day of they are suitable matches.

We do request all household members attend meet & greets including resident dogs.

If successful we will request a home check at this stage along with proof of identification and address. We will require written permission from a landlord for all applicants in rented accommodation.

Please note we require all resident dogs to be neutered and up to date with vaccinations before we will proceed with the adoption.

name: Aspen
description:
Meet Aspen, a 6 month old male Hound Cross with a bright, affectionate personality and an incredible story of resilience.

Born in March 2025, this handsome pup started life in Cyprus, where he was found abandoned and seriously ill with parvovirus — a condition often fatal in unvaccinated puppies.

Thanks to expert veterinary care, Aspen made a full recovery and has since travelled to the UK, where he’s settling beautifully into foster life in South East London.

Being deaf doesn’t hold Aspen back one bit. In fact, it gives him an edge — city noises that might unsettle other rescue dogs don’t faze him at all. He’s confident out and about, curious, and absolutely loves exploring the outdoors.

Aspen is friendly, trusting, and full of character. He adores people and thrives on interaction, soaking up every bit of affection he’s offered. He’s clever, food-motivated, and loves one-to-one training sessions — anything that earns him praise or treats.

He can live with other friendly dogs but would also be happy as the only dog in a home that gives him plenty of attention.

Aspen’s best suited to a homewithout cats or small animals, and he’d do great withdog-savvy children aged 8 and upwho understand he’s still in that bouncy, mouthy puppy phase.

Aspen would love a home with access to a garden where he can play off lead. His ideal family will be home most of the day and able to build up his confidence being left alone gradually.

With patience, structure, and love, Aspen will grow into the loyal, affectionate companion he’s meant to be.

name: Bear
description:
Bear is a 2-year-old Belgian Malinois Cross American bulldog.

Bear is currently in our kennels in Wrexham, North Wales.

Bear, our 2-year-old heartbreaker, struts his stuff on the leash like a pro, gives paw like a true gentleman, and even tucks himself in at night! We suspect he’s part Malinois, part bull breed, and all mischief.

Sure, he can jump a 6ft obstacle and redecorate with the best of them, but hey, who doesn’t love a bit of chaos?

Bear’s health is top-notch, and his intelligence is off the chats—now if only we could convince him to use it for good!

Bear is fine with other dogs when out and about but we would not rehome him with another dog in the home. He will benefit from still being socialised with other dogs outside the home.

He is best suited to a home with older children only, where he can enjoy structure, calm, and consistency.

Someone with breed experience is important as Bear is a high energy dog who is very intelligent – his new owner will need to be able to give him enough physical and mental stimulation and in reward you will have an amazing dog!

Bear is house trained, crate trained and good with everyone he meets

Once we have received your application this will be reviewed by our dog team and if you are a suitable match one of our volunteers will be in touch within 7 days to discuss your application in more detail.

You will then be invited to meet the dog, and we encourage 2-3 meet & greets for you to get to know your chosen dog, we are happy to introduce you to multiple dogs on the day of they are suitable matches.

We do request all household members attend meet & greets including resident dogs.

If successful we will request a home check at this stage along with proof of identification and address. We will require written permission from a landlord for all applicants in rented accommodation.

Please note we require all resident dogs to be neutered and up to date with vaccinations before we will proceed with the adoption.

name: Lenny
description:
Lenny is a 4-year-old small sized American Bulldog cross.

Lenny is currently in our kennels in Wrexham, North Wales.

Lenny is a 4-year-old American Bulldog cross with a sweet and gentle nature. Although a little unsure when meeting new people, once he feels safe, he blossoms into a playful, affectionate boy who loves nothing more than a good toy session!

If you are happy to throw a squeaky toy for him all day long then you will very quickly make a new best friend. He really is a gem with so much potential.

Lenny is crate trained and finds comfort in having a safe space of his own. He’s also house trained and keeps his environment clean, making him a joy to have around the home.

He travels well in the car, making him a great buddy for road trips or vet visits without the stress, in fact he seems to get more excited about being In the car than the actual walk!

He’s shown himself to be neutral and polite with other dogs when out and about on a walk, and seems disinterested in cats, but would be best as the only pet in the home,

Lenny can be a little pushy in certain situations, particularly when asked to do something he’s unsure about – a trait that’s not unusual for his breed.

Because of this, a confident, calm owner would really help him thrive. Previous experience with American Bulldogs or similar breeds would be helpful, though it isn’t essential.

He would benefit from multiple meet & greets to help build a strong bond before going home, and he’s currently available for either adoption or temporary foster.

With all the change he’s experienced lately, he’s bound to be a little confused and would really flourish in a stable, loving environment where he can feel safe and settled again.

Lenny is neutered, vaccinated, flea and wormed.

Once we have received your application this will be reviewed by our dog team and if you are a suitable match one of our volunteers will be in touch within 7 days to discuss your application in more detail.

You will then be invited to meet the dog, and we encourage 2-3 meet & greets for you to get to know your chosen dog, we are happy to introduce you to multiple dogs on the day of they are suitable matches.

We do request all household members attend meet & greets including resident dogs.

If successful we will request a home check at this stage along with proof of identification and address. We will require written permission from a landlord for all applicants in rented accommodation.

Please note we require all resident dogs to be neutered and up to date with vaccinations before we will proceed with the adoption.

name: Tilly
description:
Tilly is a 6-month-old female Cross-Breed. She’s expected to grow into a medium-sized dog, and she’s already showing off a gorgeous coat with white touches on her chest and the tips of her paws.

Her playful energy makes her a fun companion, and she loves spending time with people who give her attention.

Tilly is a 6-month-old female Cross-Breed. She’s been spayed and has picked up her first bit of training, already knowing how to sit when asked.

She gets along well with other dogs, showing a friendly and curious attitude around them, which makes her easy to integrate into a multi-dog household.

Tilly is a 6-month-old female Cross-Breed. She hasn’t met cats or children yet, so her reactions there are still unknown, but her gentle nature suggests she’ll adapt well with the right introductions.

Because of this, she’s best suited to a home with older children or an adult-only environment, where she can grow with guidance and patience.

Tilly is a 6-month-old female Cross-Breed. She will be fully vaccinated, including for brucellosis, before travelling, and she already has her passport sorted.

Currently in Romania, she’ll be delivered straight to your door, ready to start her new life with a family who sees just how sweet and promising she is.

name: Pinot
description:
Pinot is a 3-year-old male Cross-Breed. He’s a gentle, sensitive boy who has made a huge emotional journey since arriving in care.

Once deeply fearful of touch, especially near his neck, he has slowly learned to trust again thanks to patient handling and positive experiences.

Nowadays, Pinot greets people he knows with a wagging tail and a soft, hopeful smile. He’s still cautious when it comes to handling around his neck and is learning to accept a harness, so he’ll need owners willing to continue this calm, gradual rehabilitation.

His resilience and progress so far show how much potential he has to thrive.

Pinot was born with a forelimb deformity that slightly reduces his mobility, but it doesn’t cause him pain or stop him from enjoying life. Surgery isn’t needed for now, though this could be re-evaluated in the future.

He’s sociable with other dogs but equally content spending time on his own, making him adaptable for different home setups.

He hasn’t been cat tested, so a cat-free environment is recommended. While he can’t yet walk on a lead, a secure garden is essential so he can explore safely and continue building confidence at his own pace.

Pinot needs a calm, patient home with experienced owners who understand that trust takes time.

This brave little soul has worked so hard already, and with steady love and understanding, Pinot will continue blossoming into the trusting companion he’s meant to be.

name: Grace
description:
Grace is a medium sized crossbreed aged around two years old. Grace fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Grace was picked up during a spayathon in Corbeanca, Romania. She was supposed to be returned but they liked her too much to put her back on the street, she was not in a good place, it was close to the national road.

They quite rightly thought she was friendly enough to have a chance of finding a safe and proper home.

Grace is a sweet and affectionate girl that enjoys human affection and attention. She has a calm and quiet presence in the home and will be a fantastic addition to her future forever family.

She lives very amicably with the other dogs in her foster home but would be very happy to be the only dog in the home. She could live with respectful children aged eight plus. She is fine with the safe rescue cat.

name: Barnaby
description:
Our extra special boy Barnaby is approximately five years old and a rather large cross breed with the appearance of a hound.

Barnaby weighs twenty-nine kilos and measures twenty inches from shoulder to paw. Having been surrendered by his former owners as no longer able to keep Barnaby has been in our Cyprus shelter for a little over six months.

Our shelter manager is head over heels in love with Barnaby describing him as a quite unique gentle giant. She continues that Barnaby is in total control of his emotions and movements.

He is loving, loyal, affectionate and empathetic. Barnaby cares about others around and is just so affable.

His demeanour is sublime, and he oozes gentility. Any very fortunate adopting family looking for a dog of stature could really do no better. Barnaby’ s appearance is second to none and will surely turn many heads whilst out walking.

Barnaby walks really well on his lead and thoroughly enjoys his time in the car. He seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Mandy
description:
Mandy is a medium sized crossbreed aged around seven years old. Mandy fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Mandy belonged to a policeman in Romania. She lived her life on the end of a chain having litter after litter of puppies.

This miserable existence at last came to an end when he gave her and her current pups to a horrible shelter where conditions were dire. Thankfully they were rescued from there and taken to the nice shelter where we met them.

Mandy is now in a UK foster home and time spent with people is resulting in her absolutely flourishing. She is a quiet little girl who can’t quite believe her change of luck.

She is quiet, sweet and affectionate and would make a lovely addition to the home of a retired person or couple. Mandy would like to be the only dog in the home but could live with another as calm as she is.

She could live with respectful children aged ten plus. She is ok with the safe rescue cat.

name: Honey
description:
Please meet Happy Honey! Honey is a gorgeous little Poodle cross that is 9 years old, she sadly came to us after her owners health sadly rapidly declined and she was unable to walk or look after Honey anymore.

Honey is amazing and has been very well loved and looked after her entire life, she is used to small children as she has been raised around them. She is a beautiful lady and will make a very rewarding addition to her new family.

Although Honey is an older girl, she still loves her walks and a run around the farm, she adores martin and is always trotting around on his heel when we are out.

When she is indoors, she likes nothing more than a snuggle on the sofa, but when she is outside, she loves exploring and is fab in the car now.

Honey is absolutely adorable, she is an older girl but still loves a gallop around in the fields, but will also happily have a steady lead walk.

She is an amazing companion dog and will be a best friend to anyone who is lucky enough to adopt her, she is a little tubby but only a small girl, I think she is 6kg but under 10kg.

Honey is neutered, microchipped, de flea and wormed and fully vaccinated, she is house trained walks well on the lead is not destructive and can be left for short periods.

Honey is a perfect family pet and can live with children aged 6 years plus. She is a very social little lady so could live with other dogs or would be equally happy as the only dog with lots of human company!

She is absolutely fine with cats and will happily curl up on the bed with our cat! She does like to hog the sofa and the bed at night, but she will also sleep downstairs – if she must! She just adores her humans!

She is perfect off the lead and loves to chase a ball! She also loves to get wet and muddy!

Honey is very responsive and well trained. She loves her home comforts and a cuddle, and likes to sleep on the bed!

Honey travels very well in the car, whoever adopts this little lady will be very lucky indeed as she really has the most amazing well-adjusted nature and such a beautiful, cheeky face.

Honey is fine to live with cats, she doesn’t take any notice of them!

Can you offer this beautiful lady the retirement home she so desperately deserves?

name: Thelma
description:
Thelma is an adorable little Pug that is approx 3/4 years old, she is small and mighty and full of character and mischief!!

Sadly Thelma joined us as part of a welfare case along with her 5 pups and an adult male, all have now been rehomed and its her turn to find her happy ever after.

Thelma has been bred multiple times in her short life, likely every season, she was emaciated, bald, alive with fleas and feeding her pups, it was absolutely heartbreaking, and despite her obviously poor bodily condition, she was a fantastic mum to those pups and they thrived with her.

Thelma is a lively happy little lady that would love a family to play with her and keep her occupied, She loves a walk and loves to greet everyone.

She meets, and everyone that meets her adores her, she is just fantastic and such a clown!! She absolutely adores other dogs so could happily live with a companion, She can live with children 6 years plus and takes no notice of cats, except to steal their food!

Thelma is fine to be left for short periods, and is non-destructive. Thelma is a gorgeous happy, bouncy active lady that so desperately needs a forever home and family to grow up with.

She is the sweetest little cuddle bug ever – She can’t get close enough to you and roos and dances when she see’s you!

Thelma is like living with a little furry comedian, She is always making you laugh with her antics and expressions, it’s hard to be sad with Thelma in the house!!

Thelma is neutered, vaccinated, microchipped de flead and wormed.

name: Leo
description:
This lovely, gentle, large lad is Leo, a 3 year old Spanish Mastin. He has a beautiful, thick, Honey Tiger marking on his coat, white chest and unusual facial markings.

This handsome boy came to our attention because he has been waiting in a pound so long for a new home!

Leo is beautifully trained, used to living inside, and a striking looking dog with a beautiful coat, affectionate with people and social with other dogs.

He is affectionate and quite playful, calm, and avoids conflict. He walks perfectly well on a leash and is currently in a private boarding facility with other dogs.

Leo is wary of men for the first few days of living with him and so we flag this to ask new owners to be patient with this as he may bark, as it soon changes. He needs to have space to trust men.

Due to Leo’s size, we think he is better homed with children over 10 years and he can live with other dogs or as an only dog.

He is used to the lead he will thrive in a rural environment, maybe a farm, small holding or large gardens, and a family used to walking or other outside activities. He ignores cats.

name: Hera
description:
The very beautiful and incredibly affectionate Hera is waiting for her forever home…

Hera is a larger Labrador mix girl (standing about 80cm) with a blonde, soft, short coat. She was found abandoned a few months ago, she came into our care and has lapped up all the attention she can get ever since.

Hera is approximately 2 years old and, once introduced, gets on with all her kennel mates. She can be a slow burner though and a bit barky to begin with but after that it’s play time.

Hera doesn’t like cats, but she loves her walks and is a good (but can be a strong) girl on the lead. She is like a big puppy!

Hera is spayed, up to date with her vaccinations and has her passport in place so could travel to the right family, her blood tests were all clear.

We are looking for a family with no cats and children over 12 years because she jumps up with excitement, which will subside once she’s being trained in her new home.

Another friendly playful dog would be good for her too and a large enough garden for her to run around.

Living with dogs : yesLiving with cats : noLiving with children : yes over 12NEEDS to live with another dog MaybeLocated in Spain

name: Adaya
description:
This very sweet Breton Spaniel lady is aged 6 years old and is looking for her new family, hopefully with another friendly dogAdaya is a lovely, friendly and very affectionate medium-sized girl, with a white and tan (almost deep chestnut) soft coat.

When poor Adaya arrived at the shelter, she was very underweight and incredibly timid. But with good food , love and patience, this beautiful girl has blossomed into such an affectionate, loving and happy dog.

Adaya has shared her kennel happily with both male and female dogs, she loves her walks and is excellent on the lead. She has such a quiet, calm personality and is a very social girl.

She still has a little more weight to gain, but she is doing better every day and is now a much more confident girl — and she loves greeting you with her lovely waggy tail!

We loved seeing Adaya sharing with Bella. They had exactly the same chilled-out vibe — gentle, calm and just happy to be together.

Bella has now been adopted and we’re so happy for her as she really deserved some love, but poor Adaya is now pining for her.

Adaya is now neutered and has her vaccinations and passport so can travel to the right home, she has her bags packed!

We are looking for a family with an outdoors interest and an adequate garden size for her, who may have another friendly dog for play. She can be an only dog if the family are “work at home”, and children over 10 years

name: Tanya
description:
Gorgeous Tanya is a super-friendly, sweet, laid back puppy girl aged just 4 months old. She has a soft, short, cream coat and attractive facial markings.

As typical of breed, a Spanish Mastin cross, she is calm in comparison to many other breeds when a puppy.

Tanya is a good all rounder and loves other dogs and can be tested for cats. She will grow to be a larger dog. She is a wonderful girl who just adores people.

She has a trusting and very nice nature towards people and other dogs, so super social and positive, Another one that loves the open space in the shelter to run around and have fun.

We are looking for a family who prefer bigger dogs, with an outdoors interest and an adequate garden size for her, who may have another friendly dog for play. She can be an only dog if her family are work at home, and children over 10 years due to her size.

name: Blake
description:
Gorgeous Blake is a friendly, large and sometimes timid, laid-back young man aged just two and a half years old. He has a soft, short, tan and white coat and attractive facial markings.

As typical of the breed, Blake is a Spanish Mastin Cross. He is calm and a serious boy.

Blake likes other dogs and can be tested for cats. He is a wonderful boy who just adores people once he gets to know them.

We are looking for a family who prefer bigger dogs, with an interest in the outdoors and an adequate garden size for him, who may have another friendly dog for play. He can be an only dog if his family work from home, and children should be over 12 years old due to his size.

Gets on well with all dogs, likes people, has a gentle, friendly manner about him, and is laid-back.

Blake is currently in Spain and can travel to the UK in mid-September.

name: Coco
description:
Coco is a gorgeous 5 month old cross breed puppy. Mum was a small dog however we do not know who Dad was. Puppies were born in rescue in Spain and as Mum was surrendered to the shelter Mum can be seen with babies after birth.

Please ask for the photos. They are presently at the shelter in Spain and will travel directly to their adopters new homes. We also have video footage we can send via WhatsApp to the rescue number attached to this advert.

Coco will probably be a medium sized dog and Mum was very much like a Jack Russell so likely to be full of personality.

He is a happy playful boy that will benefit from an active family life with lots of playing and lovely family walks. Thanks to the dedication of caring volunteers, Coco will blossom as he waits for his own family.

There were six puppies in the litter and three have already been rehomed leaving Coco and two sisters still waiting for their homes. It would be really beneficial to them not to have to wait a lot longer.

Coco will have had all his vaccinations and his microchip but still too young for neutering. He will travel with his EU passport with his chip registered in the passport.

We believe he is just the right addition for a family looking for a young dog to complete the family.

Please in the first instance send us some information regarding your type of home, your secured garden space and your working patterns. Ensure everyone in the home is in agreement for adopting a pet.

Once we have completed a video call home check you fund the rest of your dogs costs and we co-ordinate the adoption and transport to your home.

name: Max
description:
Max is a strikingly handsome, loyal and intelligent boy who is ready for his new life. At approximately 18 months old and 30 kilos, Max is a large male German Shepherd Cross with a gentle heart and a playful spirit.

Max is the kind of dog who makes an impression the moment you meet him, confident, affectionate, and beautifully connected to his people.

Great with other dogs, social, friendly and easygoingVery loyal and smart, bonds deeply and learns quicklyLoves being brushed, fussed, and played withWalks beautifully on a leadExcellent at the vets, calm and cooperativeNo reaction to the clinic’s mascot catPlays happily with our 14-year-old work experience studentHas interacted with small dogs and younger children with no issues

Healthy, fully vaccinated and neutered. And truly, he has the best set of pearly white teeth we’ve ever seen.

Max is an all-around super boy who will thrive with:

An active family with experience of large breedsSomeone home oftenChildren aged 10+ due to his sizeA home that values companionship, routine, and fun

Max cannot live with cats, but he can live with other dogs.

name: Rainbow
description:
Rainbow is one of those dogs who makes you stop and think. At just 18 months old, Rainbow has already learned so much.

She is house trained, crate trained, comfortable being left alone, excellent in the car, and comfortable with a harness and lead. She is used to busy households and office life, and is happy around TV, music, meetings and everyday household noise.

She is wonderful with people, including men and women, good with children, good with birds, and fantastic at the vets. And she’s a clever girl too!

SitHigh fiveStayHeelTurn“Safety”“Chill” / place

She is a beautifully trained young dog who has already learned how to live alongside her people and fit into everyday life.

And then there’s Rainbow herself. She is affectionate, funny, intelligent and full of character.

Her absolute favourite thing in the world? Getting wet! Rainbow LOVES lying in water and is perfectly happy joining you in the shower for some peanut butter bribery!

She also has very refined culinary tastes: carrots, cucumbers, cheese. Honestly, she’s a girl who knows what she likes!

Rainbow would love a home where her size and breed type are understood and appreciated. Experience with large breeds, shepherds or livestock guardian-type dogs would be advantageous.

A secure gardenAn active but balanced lifestyleContinued positive training and engagementSomeone who understands the independence and instincts that can come with guardian breedsA family committed to making her a permanent part of their lives

She is fully vaccinated, fully health checked, has had blood tests, and is spayed.

name: Sophie
description:
*** SOPHIE WILL COME TO FOSTER IN BANSTEAD, SURREY, ON 20TH SEPTEMBER 2026 ***

Our extra special girl Sophie is around three years old and almost certainly a Labrador or thereabouts. Sophie weighs twenty-four kilos and measures seventeen inches from shoulder to paw.

Very sadly, Sophie’s owners were forced to surrender her to our Cyprus shelter two weeks ago.

Sophie is described by our shelter manager as a natural and experienced family dog. She is well trained and complies to basic commands. Sophie has a beautiful personality, and she is both sensitive and loving.

With her glorious white coat Sophie is visually stunning, and the subtle hints of tan are sublime.

Her piercing eyes, adorable ears and near perpetual smile make Sophie the absolutely ideal adoption candidate for the most fortunate of families who will be showered with love.

Sophie walks nicely on her lead and enjoys her time in the car. She seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs and children but there is a tendency to chase cats.

name: Rama
description:
Rama is a medium sized crossbreed aged around a year old. Rama fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Rama was a pup born to a chained mum in Romania. Thankfully she was spared the horrendous fate of chained life when all of the dogs were handed over to a rescuer, Rama and her mother included.

Rama is a quiet and sweet little girl who has lived in the shadow of her mum at the shelter. She’s now in a UK foster home and time spent with people is resulting in her absolutely flourishing.

She is a quiet little girl, currently a little serious for her age, hopefully in the coming weeks she will learn more about the fun side of life.

She mixes well with other dogs and is fine with the safe rescue cat, she could also be the only dog in the home. She could live with respectful children aged six plus.

name: Pippa
description:
Pippa is a small to medium sized collie / spaniel type crossbreed. She is around three years old. Pippa fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Pippa was found by the side of a road in Romania. She was all alone and covered in ticks. She was rescued and taken to a safe shelter and is now here in the UK looking for a new home.

Pippa is a very submissive girl and gives indication that she may have been beaten in her previous life. She is afraid of the safe rescue cat and won’t even look at him.

She mixes well with calm and placid dogs but would also love to be the only dog in the home. She would like a quiet and peaceful home where she can fully relax at last. She would like a home with no children.

name: Lucy
description:
Lucy is a 4 month old chihuahua cross girl who is expected to be smaller medium size when fully grown. Lucy’s had a difficult start in life, she was found with her mum and sister in a deprived area where her mum had been badly treated.

Her past could have made her fearful, but luckily it didn’t, and Lucy is full of trust and love.

This beautiful girl is a happy, friendly puppy who loves cuddles and being close to people, she is a true lapdog. She is a true puppy, full of life, loves to play and explore. She is jolly happy girl with a fun character.

Lucy is a sweet affectionate puppy, she loves dogs and could happily live with a doggie mate or be the only dog in the home.

She is also happy around children and could live with older dog savvy kids.

We can also cat test her for the right applicant.

Lucy dreams of cuddles in bed, fun adventures, belly rubs and a family to love for the rest of her life.

Lucy is in Hungary and will travel to the UK once a home has been secured for her.

name: Sully
description:
Sully is a 5 year old medium size male cross breed. He looks like someone accidentally shrunk a Rottweiler in the wash. He’s handsome, compact, and has mastered the art of looking at you as if he’s contemplating the meaning of life.

Sully’s story didn’t begin so happily, he was surrendered in Hungary by a British family along with several other dogs.

They arrived frightened of people, fearful of new experiences, and clearly hadn’t been shown the love, kindness and guidance that every dog deserves.

For Sully the world was a scary place initially. But then he saw people who were kind to him, spoke gently, and gave him time. And it didn’t take long for him to realise that not all humans let you down.

Today Sully is a completely different dog, he enjoys life and likes human company, and although he still has his moments of insecurity, he is now curious and not fearful of the world around him.

He is a loyal, kind natured boy, quite placid in temperament. He isn’t a high energy dog either who would need endless adventures and entertainment all through the day, but he will happily join you on your walks and then enjoy home time sharing the sofa with you.

What he really wants though is a family who won’t give up on him.

Sully is friendly with most dogs with sensible introductions, very excitable dogs are probably not the best match for him but he could happily live with a friendly placid dog.

He is friendly around children, too, but he would probably be best suited to an adult-only home as he is not used to the noise and chaos that can come with young children.

We can cat test him for the right applicant.

He would really love to leave his shelter days behind and start a new life.

And he comes with a special bonus in that he understands English!

Sully is in Hungary and will travel to the UK once the right family is found for him.

He comes neutered, microchipped, fully vaccinated, with an EU pet passport.

name: Lana
description:
Lana is a 4 month old chihuahua cross girl from Hungary who is expected to be smaller medium size when fully grown.

Lana has already had a difficult start in life, she was found with her mum and sister in a deprived area where her mum had been badly treated. Despite everything they have been through, Lana has chosen love over fear.

This beautiful girl is a happy, friendly puppy who loves cuddles and being close to people, she is a true lapdog. She has a slightly calmer nature than her sister, but still enjoys playing, exploring and having fun.

She is a sweet affectionate puppy who could happily live with a doggie mate or be the only dog in the home.

She is also happy around children and can live with older dog savvy kids.

We can also cat test her for the right applicant.

Lana has never known what it’s like to belong to a family of her own, but she’s ready to learn. She dreams of cuddles in bed, fun adventures, belly rubs and people to love for the rest of her life.

Lana is in Hungary and will travel to the UK once a home has been secured for her.

name: Trixy
description:
Trixy is a 1.5-year-old, smaller medium crossbreed girl with a heart full of love. She was rescued from the streets alongside her mum (a Dachshund cross) and four siblings.

Three of the pups, including Trixy, are still waiting for their happy ending in a shelter in Hungary.

Trixy is a lively, playful young girl who sometimes shows a little shyness at first. But once she feels safe, her sweet, cuddly side shines through — she only needs love, patience, and kindness to truly thrive.

She adores playing with her doggie friends and gets along well with them.

She is friendly with people, including children, and enjoys her walks, trotting happily on the lead. Trixy would be happiest in a family where she isn’t left alone for long hours and is treated as a true member of the family — joining in on adventures, cuddles, and daily life.

She could easily share her home with another playful, gentle dog, or be the only pet, soaking up all the love and attention. Like all rescue dogs, she will need time, patience, and commitment from her new family to settle and blossom into the wonderful companion she is meant to be.

Trixy is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK once her perfect family is found. She will come spayed, fully vaccinated, microchipped, and with an EU pet passport.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

attributes.Breed: Staffordshire bull terrier cross labrador retriever

name: Zelda
description:
Meet Zelda, a 2 year old female Staffordshire Bull Terrier cross Labrador Retriever — a brave and beautiful girl who has survived unimaginable cruelty yet still greets the world with love.

She came from hell. Zelda spent her early life chained so short she couldn’t even stand, the chain cutting deep into her neck. Despite such cruelty, she never lost her spark. Once freed, she greeted her rescuers with a wagging tail and a forgiving heart.

Now safe, she’s blossomed into an energetic, happy-natured girl. She’s medium-sized, affectionate, and adores people.

Zelda gets along well with other dogs — though she can be a bit boisterous in her play — and would thrive either as an only dog or with a friendly, tolerant companion.

In the kennel, she doesn’t get the exercise or freedom she craves, and she’s longing for a home where she can run, play, and finally just be a dog. She loves her walks, though she does pull on the lead, simply excited to be out exploring the world she missed for so long.

Zelda would suit an active home that can give her the exercise, structure, and affection she craves, so her joyful spirit can shine at long last. Older children will be considered.

Zelda has endured pain no animal should ever know. She deserves a life full of love, freedom, and fun.

Fully vaccinated, spayed, microchipped, with an EU pet passport. Ready to travel.

name: Harley
description:
Our extra special girl Harley is approximately five years old and an incredibly attractive small cross breed. Harley weighs just twelve kilos and measures ten inches from shoulder to paw.

Harley has been in our Cyprus shelter for six weeks having been found abandoned on the streets.

Our shelter manager describes Harley as very loving and perfectly behaved. With impeccable manners and a near perpetual smile she is an absolute delight.

Harley’s personality attracts a huge fan club among the shelter staff and volunteers, and she is everyone’s favourite.

She is visually stunning with her pretty face and tri colour coat. Harley is at her happiest having fun with people and cherishes every moment on a lap or having a cuddle.

She is exceptionally low maintenance and will make a wonderful addition to her adopting family.

Harley enjoys her time in the car and seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs and children. She is not however cat tolerant.

name: Kevin
description:
Kevin is a male medium sized crossbreed aged around nine months old. Kevin fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Kevin and his brother Kyron were rescued from a field in Romania in the dead of winter. They were there with their mother, Kara. Thankfully they were taken to a private shelter and kept safe until we could offer them a place here in the UK.

Kevin is a very kind and affectionate dog who loves people. He is still a pup and therefore will need guidance and training. He loves children and could live with respectful children of any age.

He mixes well with other dogs but could also live happily as the only dog in the home.

name: Rosco
description:
Rosco is a medium sized crossbreed aged around ten months old. Rosco fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Rosco’s story told by his rescuer in Romania.

“Rosco was found in our community in the yard of some fools who keep their dogs unneutered. We rescued his mother (Roua), six of Rasco’s siblings, and Davina who had given birth a week earlier from that place.

It was -10 degrees outside, and they were lying on the ice. One puppy could not be saved because it had frozen to death.”

Rosco grew up in the safety of the private shelter after his rescue. We met him in June when we visited and he showed us what a loving and friendly boy he was growing up to be. He is now in a UK foster home looking for a forever family.

Rosco is a very friendly boy who loves human company. He would be fine to live with respectful children of any age. He mixes well with other dogs but could also be the only dog in his forever home.

name: Enid
description:
Enid is a small to medium sized whippet like crossbreed, she is believed to be around three to four years old. Enid fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Enid came into our care a few weeks ago from the Botosani public shelter in Romania. She is initially a little shy but with love and kindness grows in confidence fairly quickly.

She mixes well with other dogs and would need another dog in her forever home. She would be ok to live with respectful children aged twelve plus.

name: Agika
description:
Agika is a 1 year old female Cross-Breed. She is a small cross-breed girl looking for her forever family.

This little girl has suffered so much in her short life; still, she is a little miracle. She was rescued from a heartbreaking situation where she had been kept on a short chain that had grown deep into her neck.

Once she was released, the chain had to be surgically removed.

Despite a truly rough start, Agika is a real sweetheart—loving, affectionate, and full of life. When she was rescued, she was timid and afraid of the world.

However, she soon left her old self behind, learned that some people can be trusted, and has grown into a joyful dog who loves life, loves other dogs, and now loves people too.

She walks nicely on the lead and looks forward to her walks, which she does not get many of.

She loves attention and will happily accept any amount of cuddles or affection. Agika is ready to start a new life in a safe, loving home where she will be treated the way she has always deserved.

She wants to be part of the family and discover all the things she has not yet had the chance to see or sniff.

Experience with rescue dogs is preferred but is not essential, as all applications are assessed individually.

Agika is in Hungary and will travel to the UK once a home has been secured for her. She comes spayed and fully vaccinated, with an EU pet passport.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full rescue backup is provided.

name: Percy
description:
Percy, affectionately known as Percy pig, is a medium sized crossbreed aged around six years old. Percy fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Percy came into our care recently as his owner could no longer look after him. After an initial few days of shyness he evolves into a sweet and loving boy who will subtly ask for a fuss.

Percy has lived with dogs and cats but could also be the only dog in his forever home . He walks nicely on a lead and is a calm and quiet addition to the family. He would like an adult only home.

name: Lola
description:
*** LOLA WILL COME TO FOSTER IN BANSTEAD, SURREY, ON 20TH SEPTEMBER ***

Our extra special girl Lola is approximately five years old and a German Shepherd dog or thereabouts. Lola weighs twenty-five kilos and measures eighteen inches from shoulder to paw.

She was a much-loved dog by her family who had to leave the country under the most tragic circumstances. Hence Lola has been in our Cyprus shelter for over six months.

Our shelter manager describes Lola as highly intelligent, loving and loyal. She has the most delightful disposition and an adorable nature.

Lola responds to basic demands and will sit on demand. She will gaze at her food bowl until instructed to eat. Lola has settled really well into shelter life and has forged many endearing relationships.

Her amazing tricolour is beautifully enhanced by her white tips. Lola is an absolute star and the perfect adoption candidate for a very fortunate adopting family.

Lola walks nicely on her lead after a short period of excitement. She seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children. Lola is such a prize.

name: Chill
description:
Chill is a 1-year-old smaller medium-sized Puli girl with the softest eyes and the gentlest soul.

This beautiful girl was found abandoned alongside another Puli cross and taken to a kill shelter, where her future looked uncertain. Thankfully, she was given a second chance and came into our care.

When Chill first arrived, she was timid and reserved, unsure of the world around her. But once she settled into boarding and realised she was safe, her true personality slowly began to shine.

Today, her tail is up, she greets us with a smile, and every day she grows a little braver.

True to her name, Chill is exactly that – calm, quiet, easy-going and wonderfully relaxed. She is relaxed around other dogs, too and mingles beautifully with them, although she can feel overwhelmed by noisy or boisterous dogs.

She walks nicely on the lead and has a peaceful, gentle nature.

After being abandoned once, we would love her next chapter to be the one she truly deserves — a home where she will never be left behind again, where she is included in everyday life and can become a treasured member of the family.

Currently in Hungary and ready to travel to the UK once the right family is found.

name: Malna
description:
Malna is a 3 year old crossbreed girl, she was dumped on the roadside along with her sister at about 2.5 months of age. She is medium size, weight: 15 kg, shoulder height: 44 cm.

Malna is a lovely girl, she is friendly and kind and loves everyone. She is energetic and playful and sociable around her doggie mates.

She enjoys nothing more than running around in the fields with other dogs, playing a chase. She cooperates nicely with humans too and is very kind with humans.

She enjoys car rides and is good around children too. She also walks nicely on the lead.

Malna would be best suited for a family where she is not left alone for extended periods and she is included in her family’s activities. She would be happiest in an active family, she would happily be your company on long walks, hikes and holidays.

Older dog savvy children will be considered.

Malna would probably be happiest living with another playful dog but she could also live happily as the only dog and the centre of attention in her home.

As all rescue dogs, she will need time, patience, love and commitment from her adopting family to become a happy, well-balanced dog.

Malna is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK as soon as the right family is found for her.

She comes spayed, fully vaccinated, microchipped, dewormed, flea and tick treated, with an EU passport and DEFRA approved paperwork.

Adoption is subject to Home Check and Adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Tango
description:
Tango is a 2 year old male Cross-Breed. He was saved from the streets with his 4 siblings and their mum, who is a Dachshund cross.

Tango is a very kind-natured boy—friendly, affectionate, and playful. He has a beautiful, friendly look and a well-proportioned build. He loves people and enjoys a lively, playful lifestyle.

He is very social with his doggie mates and plays well with them.

Tango would be best suited for a family where he is not left alone for extended periods and is treated as a family member. He would love to go on nice adventures! He will need time to settle into his new home, and his training will need to be continued.

He could live happily with another friendly, playful dog or as the only dog in the home, being the centre of attention.

As with all rescue dogs, he will need time, patience, love, and commitment from his adopting family to become a happy, well-balanced dog. Experience with rescue dogs is preferred.

Tango is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK once the right family is found for him.

He comes fully vaccinated, microchipped, dewormed, flea and tick treated, with an EU passport and DEFRA-approved paperwork.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Lizzie
description:
Lizzie is a medium sized crossbreed aged around four to five years old.

Lizzie came into our care around a year ago after we met her on a trip to the Botosani public shelter in Romania. She was scarily emaciated back then and we did wonder if she would survive long enough for us to get her to the UK. She did make it onto the bus and arrived safely in her uk foster home.

Lizzie was always curious about people and happy to be around them but was initially afraid to be actually touched but is now a very affectionate and loving girl with huge enthusiasm for human contact.

Lizzie enjoys the company of other dogs and would prefer another, full time resident, dog in her forever home. She would be ok as an only dog if someone was home most of the time and she had plenty of interaction with other dogs out on walks.

Lizzie is a playful and cheery girl who enjoys her walks. She can be wary of tall men in the home until she gets to know them well. Lizzie is fine with the safe rescue cat and can live with children aged twelve plus.

name: Whiskey
description:
Whiskey is a medium sized crossbreed aged three to four years old.

We met Whiskey about eighteen months ago when we found him in an emaciated state in the Botosani public shelter. We immediately moved him to a private shelter where he would be able to eat properly and gain weight.

Eventually we were able to take him in the UK

On arrival Whiskey was very distrustful of us, but he now loves us so much he can barely contain it all . Whiskey is very playful and will need another dog in his forever home as full time resident.

He’s still wary of strangers but when he loves you he is the most loyal and affectionate boy. Whiskey walks nicely on a lead but is still a bit wary of having the lead put on and taken off, we will continue to help him grow more confident with this whilst he’s in our care.

Whiskey will need someone experienced with nervous dogs as gaining his trust initially wil take time. Once the bond is made though he is truly a dog in a million.

name: Elena
description:
Elena is a five to six year old female Cross-Breed who is medium to large in size and currently fostered in Marlborough, Wiltshire.

She can live with or without other dogs, can live with children of all ages, and has not yet been cat tested, though she may be suitable.

We met Elena in March this year when we visited the Boto?ani public shelter in Romania. She had a badly twisted front leg. She had two operations to try and fix the damaged limb, but sadly they didn’t work and it was ultimately amputated.

Elena is the most joyous dog you could ever meet. Despite her surroundings in the grim shelter she remains bubbly and upbeat.

She is friendly and affectionate and loves everyone she meets. Elena mixes well with other dogs but could also live happily as the only dog in the home. She could live with respectful children of all ages.

name: Cessil
description:
Cessil is a medium sized crossbreed aged around four years old. Cessil fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Cessil has come into our care recently from the Botosani public shelter where he has been imprisoned for at least the last couple of years.

Cessil is an affectionate and fun dog once you get to know him but is initially hand shy with strangers. Cessil loves the company of other dogs and will need at least one other dog as permanent resident in his forever home.

Cessil has initially been quite resistant to lead training but is now getting the hang of it and will just need to build up confidence with practise in his forever home. He could live with respectful children aged twelve plus.

name: Sara
description:
Sara is a medium sized crossbreed born December 2021.

Sara has came into our care from Romania at a year old as her carer there was moving to the UK and she was worried for her future.

Sara is a placid and sensitive girl who can be a little cautious of new people. She quickly warms up to family though and is an affectionate and friendly girl.

Sara mixes well with other dogs but could also live as an only dog. She would need an adult family as she can be anxious around playful behaviour.

Sara needs a calm and quiet home environment as she can be very anxious around visitors to the home. She is such a loving and sweet girl to her family but has spent three years in our care now with no offers of a home.

name: Hilda
description:
Hilda is a large Romanian shepherd cross. Her passport says she was born Feb 2019 but she acts a bit older than six.

We have been a part of Hilda’s life and her a part of ours for years. She was in the private shelter in Crivatu Romania the very first time we visited and stayed there until 2024.

The story of how she came to be rescued, if indeed it’s true, is too horrible to put into print so I will just say that she has been through a lot and, although understandably scared of people, treats us with nothing but gentleness.

Hilda is a large dog with a calm presence. She moves with grace and poise and is quite regal in her demeanour.

She will avoid strangers if she can but once she is used to the people in the home she will choose to be close by and always looks like she wants to come for a fuss but she’s just not quite ready yet.

When you go to her she is happy to be fussed and groomed and will fall asleep with her head on your lap.

Hilda is not keen on her walks and really doesn’t want to go for more than fifteen minutes. We are not sure if this is a crisis of confidence or if it’s a mobility issue, she’s a difficult dog to read.

She walks nicely on a lead but can panic when spooked so we are looking for a rural home for her as she will not cope with a lot of traffic or crowds.

Despite her fears Hilda is such a gentle dog, she will need a calm and quiet environment with no children under twelve and with at least one other dog.

Anyone considering adopting her must be calm and patient in gaining her trust and maybe she will never fully open up to humans due to the horrors of her past. She is fine with the safe rescue cat, but won’t look at him.

name: Peter
description:
Peter is a large crossbreed aged around fifteen months old. Peter fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Peter and his siblings were found in a city in Romania last January. Small pups, lost and wandering among cars and all sorts of dangers. The man who found them, being a friend of a friend, asked for Roxana’s help and they were taken to her shelter.

Peter has been on our care since last July. For most of that time he was very neurotic and skittish but recently we’ve all noticed an element of him maturing and becoming a lot more confident.

He still spooks at some things but the spooky reaction is not so melodramatic and passes quickly.

Peter is a sweet boy once he knows you, he’s not ready for strangers being hands on with him but he gets used to new people so much faster now and we’re still working daily on improving his confidence.

Peter will still need an experienced adopter with the time and patience to continue with his confidence building. He will need a calm and steady household with no children.

He will need a confident dog in his forever home that will play with him as he loves the rough and tumble of his foster pack.

name: Romeo
description:
Romeo is a chunky medium sized crossbreed aged around six years old. Romeo fostered Norwich Norfolk.

He has come into our care recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania.

We’ve known this boy for over two years now and walked him on several trips to the shelter. He’s always been so happy to see us and a really nice boy to take out. He’s very friendly and confident.

Romeo could live very happily with a female dog or dogs but would also enjoy being the only dog in the home. He could live with respectful children aged ten plus.

name: Finn
description:
Finn is a five to six month old crossbreed pup who we believe will grow to be medium sized. Finn fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Finn has come into our care recently from the Boto?ani public shelter in Romania. He is initially quite hand shy with new people but his confidence is growning daily.

He is much braver when he has an adult dog to shadow around and we would therefore need to find him a home with at least one other dog in permanent residence.

He is mixing well with the safe rescue cat and will need a home with children no younger than twelve.

He will need all the usual training and care that all pups need and adopters should expect peeing, poohing, chewing and potentially sleepless nights until work is put into training them out of it.

name: Ralph
description:
Ralph is a medium sized golden Labrador cross aged around eight years old. Ralph fostered Taverham Norfolk.

We believe this boy to be Rupert’s son and he’s an absolute chip off the old block with both looks and stubborn mannerisms.

Poor Ralph spent years in the Botosani public shelter in Romania, his two brothers are still there and can’t come to us until we’ve found homes for the two such similar souls that we have already!

Ralph is a sweet old soul that is learning all about his new domestic life, but he’s insistent on putting up a little bit of protest regarding “new tricks” such as walking on a lead.

He’ll do it, and he’ll enjoy the walk, but he’s just gotta tell you first that he doesn’t appreciate being restricted to going where the humans want him to go. If he wants to sniff something, he’s going to let you know, he’s just actually very amusing!

He asks for a fuss but then looks confused about why he’s asked and why he’s enjoying it, but you can see that he is . It’s a lot to get used to and he’s just through the process in his own unique way and we’re loving watching it happen.

Ralph gets on with other dogs to a point but would rather be the only dog in the home. Despite never having a bed or bedding in his life before, he’s decided he likes them and he doesn’t want to share them.

It’s all bluster and bravado but perhaps it would be easier just to let him have his own way in this one and let him be the only dog in the home, he does deserve to be spoilt after all! He could live with respectful children aged twelve plus.

Despite all the comedy antics, Ralph is so happy to be here and be around the humans who he seems to understand are just trying to love him and be his friend. His tail is wagging a lot these days and he just needs his own forever home to wag it in!

name: Neddy
description:
Neddy is a medium sized crossbreed aged around ten months old. Neddy fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Neddy was part of a litter that were found abandoned somewhere in Corbeanca, Romania, in a field. No mum with them. A lady contacted rescuers and begged for help… Bianca took them to her shelter.

The only girl left for Belgium, the daughter of the lady who found them adopted her. One boy left for Germany.

Dave arrived a couple of months ago and was successfully adopted and now Neddy has arrived along with the other two remaining siblings to find their happy ever afters.

Neddy is a very sweet and playful boy who is loving the adventure of the change to a UK foster home. He’s having great fun playing with other dogs and humans alike.

He’s having could live with other dogs or as an only dog. Loves his toys and fuss and walks nicely on a lead. He could live with respectful children aged ten plus.

name: Tara
description:
Tara is a small to medium sized female crossbred aged around twelve years old. Fostered in Rollesby Norfolk.

Tara originally came into our care several years ago. She was rehomed along with two other of our dogs but they have sadly all had to come back to us recently as their adopters unexpected health issues means she can no longer care for them.

Tara has lived with cats and dogs but could happily be the only dog in the home. She loves her walks and is in good health for her age. She will need an adult family and can be wary of some men.

name: Hovis
description:
Hovis is a medium sized crossbreed aged around six years old.

We met Hovis on the last day of our trip to Botosani public shelter in Romania in March 2024. He so nearly missed being seen amongst the 800 prisoners there until at that eleventh hour his enquisitive and cheeky face appeared in the pen next door.

He was in with some very old and grumpy dogs and had been for some time. He finally boarded the van to the UK last September and has been awaiting his forever home.

Hovis is a sweet and affectionate boy who will play for hours with his canine friends in his foster home. He absolutely loves his walks but does pull a little on the lead so will need further training, he has a fabulous time when we take him to a secure field.

He loves to play with toys and would like another playful dog in his forever home if possible.

Hovis would like an adult home environment and is perfectly fine with cats.

name: Princess
description:
Princess is a medium sized Chow cross aged around five years old. Princess fostered Hockley Essex.

Princess has come into our care recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania. Life wasn’t so very terrible for her in the first few months of her stay at Botosani.

Her and her brother were in a pen on their own and they had each other to snuggle up to and play with. A few weeks ago we were gutted to learn that her brother left the shelter and she remained behind.

We’ve been conspiring to get her from the very second we knew he left as we were eaten up by how miserable she would be and how she simply wouldn’t understand why he suddenly vanished.

Our hearts literally ached for her. We’ve had set backs along the way and it’s taken far longer than we wanted but, finally, she is in a UK foster home and she’s having a ball.

Princess is an incredibly friendly and cheerful girl who settled instantly in her foster home and quickly behaved like she’d never lived anywhere else!

She gets on well with her foster siblings but could also live happily as the only dog in her forever home. She could live with respectful children aged eight plus.

name: Britney
description:
Britney is a medium, sized, lab-type crossbreed of around 3-4 years old.

Britney is fostered in Marlborough Wiltshire.

We met Britney and her mum and sister when we visited the Botosani public shelter in Romania at the beginning of October last year.

All three travelled to the UK to start a new life away from the horrors of the shelter, and both mum and sister are now happily living in their forever homes.

Britney is a friendly and affectionate girl who is submissive and hand-shy at first, but once she is settled she is extremely sweet and loves a fuss and a cuddle.

Britney will need a resident dog(s) in her new home. She would also be ok with confident cats and respectful children aged eight and over.

name: Theo
description:
Our extra special boy Theo is, we believe, between four and five years old and an amazing little cross breed with a strong Kokoni semblance.

Theo weighs thirteen kilos and measures twelve inches from shoulder to paw. Having been surrendered by a very distressed and poorly owner, Theo has been in our Cyprus shelter for six weeks.

Our shelter manager describes Theo as a superhero who walks perfectly on his lead and has impeccable manners.

She adds that Theo enjoys a lovely personality with a near perpetual smile. Theo is bright, alert, attentive and thoroughly enjoys a treat.

He’s at his happiest when socialising with people and really savours a lap and cuddle.

Being such an affable little chap Theo is a readymade adoption candidate who will prove to be very low maintenance and incredibly affectionate.

Theo is very happy during his car journeys. He mixes perfectly well with other dogs and children but has a strong propensity to chase cats. Theo can’t live with cats.

name: Marco
description:
Meet Marco — a beautiful 2 year old hound mix, 16.5 kilos with soulful eyes and a heart that is still learning that it is safe to love.

Some dogs arrive in rescue carrying invisible scars. Marco is likely one of those dogs.

As a hound, he was probably expected to be something he simply wasn’t meant to be—a hunting dog. But not every hunting breed is born for that life, and sadly, the gentle ones, like Marco often get left behind.

Marco shows many of the familiar signs of an abandoned hunting dog: a little fear, some uncertainty, and a cautious way of moving through the world… as if life has taught him to be careful.

But despite this , something beautiful shines through. Marco hasn’t given up on people. He still wants to trust and still wants to be loved.

This sweet boy loves to sniff and explore the world through his nose, just as hounds do. Watching him follow a scent is watching him do what comes naturally to him.

For Marco, walks aren’t about distance or speed—they’re about discovery, smells, and freedom. A long lead and safe adventures would make him incredibly happy.

Marco is wonderful with other dogs and truly benefits from their company. We believe he would thrive with a happy, confident dog friend who can help show him that life doesn’t always have to feel scary.

The kind of bond you build with a rescue dog like Marco is never instant—but it is profound. Because when a cautious dog finally chooses to trust you, it means everything and you will see the dog he was always meant to be….. Loving. Loyal. Gentle. Devoted.

Marco is looking for a calm, understanding home with children over 10, patient humans, and hearts big enough to let him bloom in his own time. Marco doesn’t need saving anymore. He needs belonging.

name: Yochan
description:
Meet Yochan — a beautiful 2 year old, male Pointer cross, 18 Kilos, whose journey is a story of courage, trust, and quiet transformation.

When Yochan first came to us, he wouldn’t approach people at all. He kept his distance, unsure, guarded, and not ready to trust.

Because look at him now. Now, Yochan comes running for hugs.

Yes – the same dog who once stayed far away now chooses human connection. He actively seeks affection and will quietly sit beside you, patiently waiting to be stroked, soaking in every gentle touch.

His progress has been beautiful to witness.

Yochan is a gentle soul with a soft heart. He has medium energy, enjoys companionship, and has a calm sweetness about him that makes people fall in love once they truly see him.

He is good with other dogs and could happily live as an only dog, but if he had a canine companion, a confident female dog would likely suit him best.

We do expect that moving into a home may feel overwhelming at first. Like many sensitive rescue dogs, Yochan may initially become shy or partially shut down in a new environment.

We already know what Yochan is capable of. We have already seen him bloom. We have already seen fear turn into trust. Distance turn into affection. Caution turn into love.

Because the dog waiting underneath that initial shyness is incredible.

The real Yochan is loving, gentle, affectionate, and deeply loyal.

“Take your time. I’m not going anywhere.”

And for a dog like Yochan, those words can change everything.

name: Bonnie
description:
Bonnie is a female Pointer Cross approximately 2 years old and 20 kilos and the amazing mum of 8 puppies.

At the end of May bonie was found in the middle of a road feeding 3 puppies. One of our amazing volunteer fosterers offered to get her and found a further 5 puppies!!

Our lovely Foster mum and her son, are now looking after them all at her home.

Bonnie has shown her true loving, kind and gentle self, she happily plays with the other dogs but is equally content to take a nap in a quiet area.

She loves nothing more than a million tummy tickles, and then maybe even more tickles. She is a tiny bit shy but that’s expected, in no time at all she trusts.

She also lives with cats, there is no aggression, there are hens there too. Happy to share food and has no resource guarding.

Her lead walking is fine , this will need further training and practice, she is after all a Pointer cross, any recall training will require time.

Bonnie sleeps quietly through the night, she is clean over night too. Appears to travel quietly in a car with some uncertainty.

Bonnie’s ideal home is a family with people around quite a bit, although she is used to being left for a number of hours.

We believe her confidence in the big wide world will benefit from another canine companion and a secured lovely garden, she loves the outside in the warm sun.

Above all a family that will continue with her training, shower her in love, kindness and offer her the exercise and stimulation her breed needs.

Please, please, share Bonnie’s story, she can only stay with the foster lady until August , and we don’t want to have take her to kennels in Cyprus after her life with a family.

name: Archie
description:
Meet Archie — a beautiful 2 year old young male Pointer cross with a gentle heart and so much potential. Archie carries the familiar story of many hunting dogs we see. Too gentle to hunt and so abandoned

At just 2 years old, he already shows the emotional scars of a dog who likely learned that the world could be unpredictable and frightening. Sudden movements and loud noises still startle him. New people can feel overwhelming.

So when Archie feels unsure, he does what many sensitive dogs do

But what makes Archie so special is this:

He is trying. Every single day, he gets a little braver. Every single day, he chooses trust a little more.

And when he feels safe enough, you get a glimpse of the real Archie.

A playful boy who enjoys toys. A sweet soul who wants connection. A young dog who is slowly discovering that life can actually be good.

Archie is wonderful with other dogs and would especially benefit from a happy, confident dog companion who can help guide him and show him that the world isn’t so scary after all.

He could potentially live as an only dog, but we truly believe another stable dog would help him flourish

He may also suit a home with dog-savvy children aged 12+ who understand calm, respectful interactions.

Archie doesn’t need someone to “fix” him. He simply needs someone willing to say:

“You are safe now. Take all the time you need.”

And once Archie fully believes that… we think he is going to be extraordinary.

Could you be the person who helps Archie write the next chapter of his story?

name: Shannon
description:
Shannon is a medium sized collie type crossbreed aged around two years old. Shannon fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Shannon has come into our care recently due to her owner no longer being able to adequately care for her.
