Shannon is a fun loving girl with a lot of energy and will need a fairly active home where she can be sufficiently exercised. She mixes well with other dogs but could live happily as the only dog in the home.

She is fine with cats and would need an adult only home.

Shannon is strong on a lead initially on walks but does relax a few minutes into them.

name: Junior
description:
Junior is a 3-year-old male Dachshund Cross. He was rescued from a deprived area of Hungary in very poor condition and has since been given a second chance at life. Despite everything he has been through, he has remained a sweet and affectionate little dog.

He has been waiting patiently while other dogs around him have found homes, yet he has somehow been overlooked. This is especially sad because he is described as a lovable and funny boy who truly enjoys human company.

More than anything, he is simply longing to be part of a family of his own.

Junior walks nicely on the lead and enjoys getting out and about. He loves people and shows a gentle and friendly nature in his interactions. His kind temperament also means he is patient when around children.

When it comes to other dogs, Junior’s preference is for female dogs. He would be happiest living with a spayed female companion or as the only dog in the home where he can soak up all the attention.

This flexibility means he could suit different home setups, as long as his social preferences are respected.

He comes neutered, fully vaccinated, and microchipped, which gives his future family reassurance about his health care. He also has an EU pet passport, making his travel arrangements clear and straightforward.

A home check and adoption fee will apply, and full rescue back-up is provided for added support.

Junior is a small dog at approximately 10 kg, making him a manageable size for many households. His journey has not been easy, but his gentle nature and cheerful personality have stayed intact.

He is ready to leave his difficult past behind and finally enjoy the comfort and security of a loving home.

name: Suzy
description:
Suzy is a 1.5 year old female Cross-Breed, medium in size. She was rescued exactly a year ago from horrid circumstances, having been thrown into a yard with her brother, Tommy, at just a few weeks of age.

They lived on piles of rubbish, frequently escaping due to inadequate fencing and roaming the streets among busy traffic, constantly in danger. When rescued, they were emaciated and full of parasites.

Suzy has grown to be a kind-natured, healthy girl who is active and playful according to her age. She is medium-sized and has a lovely cheeky character. She loves people and is very friendly around kids, too.

She is also playful and happy around other dogs.

Suzy is perhaps slightly more reserved than her brother and enjoys doggie company a lot. She loves to play and run with her mates.

Suzy would be happiest in a family where she is not left alone for extended periods and there is time for her training. We want her to be treated as a treasured member of the family and be taken on nice adventures. She will need time to settle into her new home and get used to her environment.

Suzy could happily live with another friendly and playful dog or dogs but may also be happy being the only dog and the centre of attention in the family.

As with all rescue dogs, she will need time, patience, love, and commitment from her adopting family to become a happy, well-balanced dog.

Experience with rescue dogs is preferred.

Suzy is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK as soon as the right family is found for her.

She comes spayed, fully vaccinated, microchipped, dewormed, flea and tick treated, with an EU passport and DEFRA-approved paperwork.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Havannah
description:
Havannah is a medium sized crossbreed aged around six years old. Havannah fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Havannah came into our care recently as her owner could no longer look after her. After an initial few days of shyness she evolves into a sweet and loving girl who enjoys a fuss and will happily curl up with you on the sofa.

Havannah has lived with dogs and cats but could also be the only dog in her forever home . She walks nicely on a lead and is a calm and quiet addition to the family.

She can live with respectful children 12 plus.

name: Tommy
description:
Tommy is a 1.5 year old male Cross-Breed, medium in size. He was rescued exactly a year ago from horrid circumstances, having been thrown into a yard with his sister, Suzy, at just a few weeks of age.

They lived on piles of rubbish, frequently escaping due to inadequate fencing and roaming the streets among busy traffic, constantly in danger. When rescued, they were emaciated and full of parasites.

Tommy and Suzy can be rehomed together or separately.

Tommy has grown to be a kind-natured, healthy dog who is active and playful according to his age. He is medium-sized and has a lovely happy character. He is very affectionate with people and friendly around kids, too.

Tommy is the more human-centred of the siblings. He loves giving kisses and is a lapdog by nature.

He is also playful and happy around other dogs.

Tommy would be happiest in a family where he is not left alone for extended periods and there is time for his training. We want him to be treated as a treasured member of the family and be taken on nice adventures. He will need time to settle into his new home and get used to his environment.

Tommy could happily live with another friendly and playful dog or dogs but may also be happy as the only dog and the centre of attention in the family.

As with all rescue dogs, he will need time, patience, love, and commitment from his adopting family to become a happy, well-balanced dog.

Experience with rescue dogs is preferred.

Tommy is currently in Hungary and can travel to the UK as soon as the right family is found for him.

He comes neutered, fully vaccinated, microchipped, dewormed, flea and tick treated, with an EU passport and DEFRA-approved paperwork.

Adoption is subject to a home check and adoption fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Maggie
description:
Maggie is a 1 year old female Cross-Breed, expected to be medium-sized when fully grown.

She is currently in Hungary and is adorable and playful, as expected for her age.

Seven siblings were born in an abandoned property with their mum struggling to feed them when she was emaciated herself.

They were taken in by the local shelter at three weeks of age.

The whole litter was stunningly beautiful, and only two pups are still waiting for their families.

Maggie is fully vaccinated, free from parasites, and ready to travel. She comes with an EU passport.

She can live with dogs and older children. The right owner will need to agree to have her spayed once fully grown.

name: Pete
description:
Pete is a large crossbreed aged around eighteen months old. Pete is fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Pete and his siblings were found in a city in Romania in January 2025. Small pups, lost, wandering among cars and all sorts of dangers. The man who found them, being a friend of a friend, asked for Roxana’s help and they were taken to her shelter.

Pete is a typical adolescent dog, clumsily learning the canine lessons of life. He is initially shy with new people and takes time to bond. He is not an overly affectionate dog but will always be close by.

Pete would love to live with another playful dog but could go as the only dog. Pete could live with respectful children aged ten plus. He will need an adopter experienced with large breeds who has the time and patience to win his trust.

name: Beigli
description:
Beigli is a 1.5 year-old medium-sized crossbreed boy with a beautiful soul. Born in an abandoned property alongside his six siblings, little Beigli’s life began in heartbreaking circumstances.

His mum was desperately trying to keep her babies alive while she herself was painfully thin and starving.

At just three weeks old, the family was rescued and brought to safety.

The puppies grew up, one by one they found their forever homes, and today only two remain: Beigli and his sister Maggie.

At just 1.5 years old, Beigli has already spent almost his entire life waiting.

He adores people, loves playing with other dogs, and has the kind, gentle nature that makes everyone fall in love with him.

All Beigli dreams of is a family to call his own. A warm bed. Daily walks. Someone to greet with a wagging tail and endless devotion.

He can live with older dog-savvy children and can be cat tested for the right applicant.

Beigli is in Hungary and is ready to travel to the UK as soon as the right family finds him.

He comes neutered, fully vaccinated, treated for parasites, with an EU pet passport.

name: Eric
description:
Eric is a small to medium sized crossbreed aged around eight to ten years old.Eric fostered Norwich Norfolk.

We originally met Eric a couple of years ago in the Botosani public shelter in Romania. After we left he was attacked at the throat by the other dogs in his pen so we asked for a space at Crivatu private shelter to move him to.

He has had a lovely time in the safety of that sanctuary for the past couple of years but it’s now his turn to get into a proper home for his twilight years.

Eric can be a quirky little chap until you get to know him but he is a dear little soul with a permanently smiling face that you cannot help but grow to love.

Eric is enjoying short walks but will need to lose some weight and build fitness gradually to enjoy a level of walking that should come more easily to him. He gets on well with other dogs and is very good with cats.

He needs an adult home environment. It’s taken a while for this little dude to come waddling to the UK and we’re hopeful that he will find his forever person or persons so that he can continue to enjoy the comforts of domestic life.

name: Jenny
description:
Jenny is a 10 year old female Airedale Terrier Cross with a heartbreaking past and a heart full of hope. For seven long years, she was left chained outside without shelter or kindness, while the world looked away.

Her suffering only came to light by chance — her rescuers were returning another dog when they saw her standing there, neglected and desperate.

Jenny’s eyes lit up as if she knew this was her moment, and when her owner was asked to surrender her, he did so without hesitation.

Since that day, Jenny has been safe, but her home has been a kennel. A whole year has passed, and she is still waiting for the love she has never truly known.

Jenny is gentle and people-oriented. She loves her walks and is good on the lead, though she can be a little strong at times. She enjoys chasing a ball and, while she isn’t interested in making doggy friends, she’s content as long as her space is respected.

Jenny would be happiest as the only dog in the home so she doesn’t have to share attention or space.

She is spayed, fully vaccinated, and travels with her EU pet passport — ready to start the new chapter she so deserves.

Jenny has lost so many years, but it’s not too late for her to find happiness! All she wants now is to spend her golden years knowing comfort, kindness, and love.

Could you give her the forever home she has waited a lifetime for?

Fully vaccinated, spayed, microchipped, with an EU pet passport. Ready to travel.

name: Dwayne
description:
Dwayne is a large mountain shepherd mix aged around seven years old. Dwayne the rock fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Dwayne has come into our care recently as his owner was no longer able to meet his needs. He is a lovely boy who needs the company of another dog in his forever home.

He’s not selective on who that dog maybe as he appears to be pleasant and sociable with all of them!

Dwayne has the dopiest grin and is a sweet and affectionate boy. We would like a home with large breed experience for him who will not be put off by his booming big boy bark .

Dwayne hasn’t been around children so will need an adult home environment.

name: Penny
description:
Penny is a 6.5-month-old female Cross-Breed. She is a small girl who weighs around 7 kilos and is currently in foster care in Nottingham. Penny came from Romania, where she had been living on the streets before being rescued by a kind vet.

Penny has now been living in Nottingham for approximately three months. She is described as a shy and sweet girl who can be nervous at first when faced with new situations.

With time, patience, and the right environment, she can continue building her confidence.

Penny would benefit from living with a confident, friendly, and playful dog or dogs. She can live with other dogs, and having canine company could provide her with reassurance as she continues to settle and become more comfortable in her surroundings.

She has not been cat tested, so her reaction to cats is currently unknown. Penny can live with older children, giving her the opportunity to become part of a family that understands she may initially need some time and space to feel comfortable.

Her lead training is currently in progress, so her new family will need to continue helping her develop her skills when out and about.

Her toilet training is also still progressing, making continued patience and consistency an important part of helping her settle into her new home.

Penny can be left alone for short periods. As a young dog who is still developing her confidence and learning about life in a home, she will benefit from people who are willing to support her progress.

Now settled in Nottingham after approximately three months in foster care, Penny is ready to find a loving forever home.

Her sweet nature and ability to live with dogs make her a lovely prospect for a family that can give her the patience, companionship, and encouragement she needs to flourish.

name: Maggie
description:
Maggie is a 7-month-old female Cross-Breed. She is a small girl who weighs around 8 kilos and is currently enjoying life in foster care in Sheffield. Maggie was rescued from Romania, where she had been abandoned on the streets as a puppy.

Despite her difficult start, Maggie is described as a sweet and playful girl.

She is well behaved both inside and outside the home and has shown herself to be a lovely companion. She is also clean in the home, which is a positive step as she continues to settle into domestic life.

Maggie can live with other dogs and is able to share her home with older children. She has not yet been cat tested, so her compatibility with cats is currently unknown.

Her new family should therefore take this into consideration when deciding whether she is the right match for their household.

Her lead training is currently in progress as she continues to learn the skills she will need for everyday life. Her toilet training is also still progressing, giving her new family the opportunity to continue building on the work already started in foster care.

Maggie can be left alone for short periods, giving her some experience of being without her people for limited amounts of time. She is continuing to learn and develop as a young dog, so a patient family willing to support her progress will be important.

Now in foster care in Sheffield, Maggie is ready to find a permanent home where she can continue growing into the happy and well-behaved dog she is becoming.

She has already shown herself to be affectionate, playful, and well behaved, and she deserves the opportunity to enjoy a secure and loving forever home.

name: Loki
description:
Loki, a beautiful 2 year old Siberian Husky needs a new home through no fault of his own.

The owner has serious health problems and is unable to give him the care and attention he needs and deserves. He is spending more and more time in kennels which is far from ideal.

Loki is a lovely boy, he loves his toys and he has a kind nature. He is currently the only dog in the household, but he is friendly with dogs and wants to play on walks so he has the potential to live with another friendly dog.

He is also used to living with older children.

He is fully vaccinated and microchipped and up to date with flea and wormingtreatments.

Loki is in Chorley, Lancashire where he is visitable upon arrangement.

name: Teddy
description:
Teddy is a 3 month old male mixed breed puppy currently living in foster care in Paphos, Cyprus.

Rescued as a tiny puppy, he has grown into a clever, cheeky and incredibly affectionate young dog.

He loves learning, enjoys playing with other dogs and has a happy, confident personality that makes everyone fall in love with him.

Teddy is expected to grow into a small/medium-sized adult and is ready to find the forever family he has been waiting for.

name: Bernie
description:
Bernie is a 2 month old male mixed breed puppy currently living in foster care in Paphos, Cyprus.

He is an adorable little boy full of confidence, curiosity and love.

He enjoys everyone he meets and is wonderful with dogs, cats and children.

Bernie is expected to grow into a small/medium-sized adult and is looking for a family ready to guide him through puppyhood with plenty of love, patience and positive training.

name: GeeGee
description:
GeeGee is a tiny 18 month old female Chihuahua × Miniature Pinscher weighing just 4kg.

She is currently living in foster care in Paphos, Cyprus.

GeeGee is the perfect combination of an affectionate lap dog and an active little companion.

She loves curling up on your lap for cuddles but equally enjoys walks, playtime and exploring.

Friendly, cheerful and full of character, she will bring endless joy to her forever family.

name: Chip
description:
Chip is a 3 month old male German Pointer cross currently living in kennels in Paphos, Cyprus.

He is full of personality, incredibly clever and always ready for fun.

He is confident, affectionate and loves everyone he meets.

Chip enjoys playing with dogs, is happy around cats and would make a fantastic family companion.

He is expected to grow into a medium to large adult and will thrive with an active family.

name: Oreo
description:
Oreo is a 3 month old female German Pointer cross currently living in foster care in Paphos, Cyprus.

She is a confident, loving puppy with a wonderful temperament and a playful personality.

She adores people, loves playing with other dogs and is equally happy living with cats and children.

Oreo is expected to grow into a medium to large adult and is looking for a family committed to giving her the love, training and adventures every puppy deserves.

name: Sunny
description:
Sunny is a medium-sized 5 year old female Pointer cross. She is currently living in foster care in Paphos, Cyprus after spending a year surviving alone on the streets.

Despite everything she has endured, Sunny is one of the gentlest dogs you could ever meet. She is quiet, affectionate and wonderful with other dogs.

Sunny is Leishmania positive and is doing exceptionally well on treatment. With routine medication and regular monitoring, she can enjoy a long, happy and normal life.

name: Wilma
description:
Wilma is a medium-sized 2 year old female cross-breed currently living in foster care in Paphos, Cyprus.

She has overcome a difficult past without ever losing her gentle and loving nature.

Wilma is wonderful with both dogs and cats and is affectionate with everyone she meets.

She enjoys a calm home life, loves cuddles and would suit a family looking for a loyal, easy-going companion who simply wants to be loved.

name: Carl
description:
Carl is a medium sized crossbreed aged two to three years old. Carl fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Carl was taken into the Botosani public shelter as a pup, nobody remembers who took him there or why. Sadly he didn’t get picked for adoption so he grew up there.

The day that the puppies there get transferred from the puppy block to the adult block is a very depressing day indeed, their chances of ever leaving decrease significantly on that short walk across the shelter

Thankfully Carl is now in a UK foster home. He is a sweet boy who is initially wary of new people but does bond after just a few days. He gets on well with the other dogs in his foster home but could also adjust to being the only dog given time.

He could live with respectful children aged twelve plus.

Carl has a deformity in one of his front legs. It’s possible that he’s had the defect from birth and it doesn’t hold him back or cause him discomfort.

name: Kori
description:
Kori is a medium to large sized crossbreed aged around five years old. Kori fostered Badersfield Norfolk.

Kori has come into our care recently after his adopters circumstances changed and they could no longer adequately care for a dog.

Kori is a beautiful sweet natured boy. He is friendly and playful with other dogs but could also live as the only dog in the home. He could live with respectful children aged ten plus and has been fine with introductions to the safe rescue cat.

name: Topi
description:
Topi is a 10-month-old medium sized cross breed boy. He is a real bundle of joy, very people-centred, affectionate and kind natured. He loves cuddles, attention, and being involved in whatever his humans are doing.

Topi is lovely friendly pup who loves to run, explore and play. He learns quickly, especially when there are treats and praise involved. His eagerness to please makes him a lovely dog to train and grow with.

He would thrive with an active family who enjoys daily walks, adventures in nature or even hiking. Topi would happily join in on family outings and would love to be part of everyday life rather than left on the sidelines.

Topi is brilliant with other dogs, and enjoys playing with them. He is very sociable and makes friends easily.

He would probably be happiest living with another friendly, playful dog, but may as well enjoy being the only dog in the home, soaking up all the attention.

Because he is still young, Topi will need time and patience to settle into a new environment and learn the routines of his new home. With kindness and guidance, he will quickly blossom into a truly wonderful companion.

He could live with older, dog-savvy children who understand how to interact respectfully with a puppy. He can also be tested with cats for the right applicant.

Topi is currently in Hungary and will travel to the UK once a home has been secured for him.

He comes fully vaccinated, microchipped, with an EU pet passport.

name: Ariel
description:
Ariel is a 6-year-old small-medium sized girl with a big personality and an even bigger heart. This feisty little terrier has been waiting in the shelter for over 3 years… far longer than any dog should have to wait.

Ariel is full of character – a true terrier spirit. She’s lively, expressive and not afraid to let you know when she’s excited – it’s all part of her charm!

She is affectionate with people and loves children, happily soaking up attention and enjoying being part of the action. Ariel forms lovely bonds and will be a loyal and loving companion to her family.

With other dogs, she is friendly with most and enjoys their company, though like many terriers, she appreciates respectful introductions and a good match in energy.

After spending such a long time in the shelter, Ariel truly deserves a home where she can finally relax, feel safe, and be loved every day.

She would love a family who will embrace her fun personality, include her in their lives, and give her the attention she’s been missing for so long.

Ariel is in Hungary, ready to travel to the UK once a home has been secured for her.

name: Badger
description:
Badger is a medium sized crossbreed aged around two years old. Badger fostered Badersfield Norfolk.

Badger originally into our care recently from the Botosani public shelter in Romania. He arrived a couple of months ago and was swiftly adopted but has sadly been reluctantly returned due to his energy levels not matching the home environment.

Badger is a brilliant character who gets on with everyone and everything. He is friendly and affectionate and a busy boy who wants to be involved in all the family goings on.

He will need a decent level of exercise in his forever home and some basic training to channel his enthusiasm for jumping up. He can live with or without other dogs and is fine with cats. He could live with respectful children of ten plus.

name: Apollo
description:
Meet Apollo – a gentle soul ready for a new life.

Apollo, a 3.5-year-old medium size cross-breed boy, whose life until now has been far from kind, has finally been freed from a life lived on a chain. Yet somehow, despite everything, he has held onto his sweetness, his trust, and his huge heart.

Apollo is incredibly human-centred, affectionate, and loving — the kind of dog who just wants to be close to people and soak up kindness.

He is wonderfully sociable with other dogs, big and small, and plays beautifully and politely with them. He’s also an absolute dream at the vets, calm and cooperative — everyone who meets him falls for his sweet nature.

He even has the potential to live with cats; in his previous life, he used to sleep in his dog house with a cat companion, sharing warmth and comfort.

He travels nicely in the car, walks well on the lead, and is more than ready to start discovering what family life means.

Currently, Apollo lives in boarding kennels, hoping that one day someone will finally choose him.

Apollo has so much love to give — he just needs someone who will finally give him the life he has always deserved. ?

Apollo comes neutered, fully vaccinated, microchipped, and with an EU pet passport.

He is ready to travel from Hungary as soon as his family is found.

name: Alfie
description:
Alfie is a German shepherd cross aged around four years old. Alfie fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Alfie and his siblings were found as puppies in a wood yard in Romania adjacent to a very busy highway. The three pups were rescued and taken to a safe shelter where they grew up safely.

Alfie’s two sisters, Alice and Alba, were adopted along the way but Alfie has spent four years waiting for his chance to come to the UK to find a home.

Alfie is a biggish chap who would suit an experienced shepherd owner. He is mixing well with dogs in his foster home but maybe best as an only dog or with just one steady female.

He has met the very robust safe rescue cat and ignored him. Alfie has little experience with children and we would be looking for a home with no children under the age of twelve.

Alfie loves his walks and walks nicely on a lead.

name: Cleo
description:
Cleo is an adorable 11-month-old small mixed breed girl looking for a loving forever home. She and her three siblings were found abandoned as tiny puppies, all in very poor condition, frightened and unsure of the world around them.

With their parents unknown and their future uncertain, all they had was each other.

Thankfully, Cleo has blossomed into a wonderful young dog. Although naturally a little shy when meeting new people or experiencing new situations, she is incredibly sweet, gentle, and affectionate once she feels safe.

Her confidence continues to grow every day.

She loves playing with other dogs and enjoys spending time with people she knows and trusts. Cleo would thrive in a calm, patient home where she can continue building her confidence at her own pace.

In return, she will reward her family with unwavering loyalty and love.

Cleo could happily live with another friendly well-balanced dog and she has all the potential to live with cats, too.

As a small-sized girl, Cleo would make a lovely companion for someone looking for a gentle, kind-hearted dog.

She comes spayed, microchipped, fully vaccinated and with an EU pet passport.

name: Scribble
description:
Scribble is a largeish crossbreed aged around three years old. He has come into our care recently due to his owner not being able to care for him. Scribble fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Scribble is a great dog, very gentle despite his size and extremely placid. Due to lacking socialisation in his previous home he is playing a bit of catch up out in the big wide world but he is learning fast and has the makings of a wonderful family member.

Scribble would like the company of another dog in his forever home, he’s also extremely well behaved around cats, rabbits and goats!

He could live with respectful children aged ten plus. He would be shy initially but with a little time and understanding would soon be a loving addition to the family.

name: Gesztenye
description:
Gesztenye is a beautiful 2-year-old medium-sized brindle girl with the sweetest soul. She adores people, loves playing with other dogs and greets everyone she meets with a wagging tail and a hopeful smile.

For over two years, Gesztenye and her sister Zserbo have shared everything. They were rescued together from a kill shelter when they were only a few weeks old. They grew up side by side, slept in the same kennel, and waited together for someone to finally choose them.

Now Zserbo’s dream has come true. She has found a wonderful family in the UK.

But little Gesztenye will soon watch her sister leave… and for the first time in her life, she will be alone.

She has so much love to give and asks for so little in return – just a family to call her own.

Gesztenye is friendly with dogs and would happily live with another canine companion. She is affectionate, playful and kind natured, and can also live with older dog-savvy children.

She’s looking for a home where she will be part of family life and not left alone for long periods.

Like all rescue dogs, Gesztenye will need time, patience and love, but in return she will give you her whole heart.

Gesztenye is currently in Hungary and is ready to travel to the UK as soon as her forever family finds her.

She is spayed, fully vaccinated, treated for parasites, comes with and EU pet passport.

name: Letty
description:
Letty is a medium sized crossbreed aged around seven years old. Letty fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Letty has come into our care recently due to a change in domestic circumstances. She is a quiet and sweet girl who is initially timid with new people.

She will need a confident dog to buddy up to in her forever home and when she sees them relaxed and approaching people for fuss she will then follow suit. She would therefore not be happy as the only dog in the home.

Letty would like a quiet and calm home with no children under the age of twelve. She walks nicely on a lead and has met amicably with the safe rescue cat.

name: Connie
description:
Connie is a 2 year old female Puli Cross. Her story began in a public pound, where she grew up in harsh conditions. A year ago, she was rescued in a heartbreaking state – skin and bone, frightened and frail.

With care, love, and patience, Connie has blossomed into a happy, affectionate girl. Today she’s full of life – her waggy tail never stops, she adores treats and cuddles, and she has even learned to smile when she’s with the people she loves. This beautiful girl has learned to trust again!

Connie loves the company of other dogs and is especially playful – wrestling and mingling are her favourite games! She would be just as happy snuggling up on the sofa as she is joining in on adventures.

Connie is still waiting in a small shelter in Hungary, dreaming of her forever family. She deserves a home where she will be cherished, spoiled, and loved for the sweet, resilient girl she is.

For Connie, an experienced rescue dog home would be ideal – someone patient and understanding, ready to continue guiding her on her journey.

She could live happily with another friendly and playful dog or as the only dog in the home.

2 years oldPlayful, affectionate, sociableSpayed, vaccinated, microchipped, with EU passportCan travel to the UK once her family is found

If you can give Connie the love-filled home she has been waiting for, please get in touch.

Adoption subject to home check & fee. Full RBU provided.

name: Floki
description:
I’m a 5 year old medium size cross breed boy.

For 3.5 years, I’ve been living in a shelter in Hungary, that’s more than half my life spent waiting behind a fence, hoping someone might stop… might notice me… might choose me. But no one ever has. Sometimes I feel invisible. I’m only 5 years old.

I’m not loud or demanding. I’m patient and quiet. I’m the kind of dog who waits in silence and hopes that one day someone will see the good boy I truly am and will not walk past me.

I love my walks, and I walk beautifully on the lead. I enjoy sniffing the world and feeling the sun on my back. I love hoomans—every scratch behind the ears and every cuddle means the world to me, because I get so little affection here.

But I treasure every moment. I never take kindness for granted.

I’m calm and peaceful around other dogs. I don’t want trouble; I just want love.

And although my muzzle is beginning to grey, please don’t think I’m old. I’m still young, playful in my soft and gentle way, and I dream—every single day—of having a home, a bed of my own, and a family who finally calls me theirs.

I have spent so long waiting, but I haven’t given up.I still believe my person is out there.

If you’re reading this… maybe it’s you.Maybe you’re the one who will make sure I’m invisible no more.

Floki is ready to travel from Hungary once the right family is found.

He comes neutered, fully vaccinated, microchipped, with an EU passport.

name: Lotty
description:
Lotty is a medium sized crossbreed aged around two years old.

The team met Lotty on their trip to Roxanas shelter back in June. She was a late addition to the transport list after they noticed that she was getting severely picked on by her pen mates every time the dogs all barked.

It was decided she really needed to be free from the bullies and so she was swiftly added.

Lotty is a timid girl initially who is not brave in new situations. She is learning to accept new things all the time and becoming braver but will still need to gain life experience in her forever home.

Once comfortable she is cheeky and affectionate and great fun. Lotty will need an adult family with one other dog in the household as full time resident. She has been fine with the safe rescue cat but may chase a more nervy cat when she found her feet.

name: Max
description:
Max is a male, medium sized crossbreed pup aged around eight to nine months old.  Max fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Max and his mum and siblings were rescued from a kill shelter in Romania. Sadly no adoption offers were forthcoming for any of the family and when we met them at a private shelter in June we agreed to bring them to the UK to find new homes.

Max is initially a little timid but is learning the ways of his new world in his UK foster home. He would benefit from the company of another dog in his forever home but could also be the only pet.

He would be ok to live with respectful children aged ten plus.

name: Nady
description:
This handsome-looking, young lad is Nady, a 12 month old Cross-Breed who is a very sweet and calm, medium-sized boy, with a soft, short, fawn coat. He minds his own business and loves being petted and cuddled and likes other dogs.

Nady was rescued, with his mom and his siblings, from a horrid situation. Some evil men were trying to brick the pups up into a wall as a laugh to starve them to death, so their rescuer pulled them out of that place and took them to safety.

His rescuer needs to move for her work and can no longer stay in the place she keeps her dogs and so is desperate to home them to loving homes.

Nady isn’t tested for cats and we are looking for a family with another friendly dog , if possible, to keep Nady company and play with. Children over 12 please, as Nady hasn’t been around small children.

name: Clementine
description:
Clementine is a super-friendly, 4/5 year old, Staffordshire Bull Terrier cross lady, with an attractive, dark brindle and white coat.

She is a wonderful girl, who just adores people. She loves to lick and cuddle and has such a trusting and very nice nature towards people and other dogs.

Celementine is super social and positive and loves the whole world. Which is very surprising if you look at the video and the state she was in when saved. Someone left her like this and no one helped her for a while until the rescue took pity on her.

Clementine came to us a starving dog with a bad infection. Our vet warned us that she was unlikely to survive, but with lots of love and local free-range chicken- survive she did.

In fact, she has thrived and is now a bundle of happiness and joy. Once safe in rescue, Clementine loved the open space to run around and have zoomies.

We think she may have come from someone that had an apartment and didn’t walk her, as she just wasn’t used to open space. Now she has learnt to walk lovely on a lead.

Clementine loves being with other dogs, her best friend is a little podenco called Sydney who she shares her bed with. We have spoilt her a little and she could probably do with losing a few pounds.

We call her ‘pudding’ as she looks like a Christmas pudding with cream on the top!

Poor Clementine, all this has happened to her and it’s not her fault. She is such a loving, happy dog and would make an ideal family pet.

Clementine really is a special girl that has endured so much in her life. She has overcome everything and is now such a joy with the most unbelievable amount of love for anyone she comes into contact with.

We are looking for a family with or without another friendly dog for Clementine to play with and children no younger than 10 years, as she can be a bit clumsy. Would suit a normal family home, not out all day, with NO cats.

name: Orion
description:
Orion is a large 4 year old male German Shepherd currently living in kennels in Paphos, Cyprus.

He is looking for an experienced and understanding home where he can continue to build confidence and enjoy the stable life he deserves.

Orion is fantastic with other dogs and genuinely enjoys their company, making him an excellent canine companion. His challenges are with unfamiliar people, as he can be unpredictable due to past experiences and several triggers.

He needs patient adopters who are willing to respect his boundaries and allow him time to trust.

Orion loves long walks, enjoys learning new things and forms incredibly strong bonds with the people he loves.

name: Bonnie
description:
Bonnie is a medium-sized 2 year old female cross-breed currently living in foster care in Paphos, Cyprus.

She is a gentle, affectionate girl with a beautiful temperament and would make a wonderful family companion.

Bonnie loves people, enjoys playing with other dogs and can happily live with cats that are already part of the household.

She has the perfect balance of being playful outdoors while also loving to curl up beside her family for cuddles.

name: Kyle
description:
Kyle is an under 12 month old male Collie Cross who started his life as a stray in Spain and came into the rescue we have worked alongside for the past 15 years when he was a young puppy.

I travel to Spain twice a year with my own dogs and, because of the relationship we have built with the rescue over many years, I only bring dogs back to the UK that I have personally met, spent time with and would be happy to have living in my own home or in one of our foster homes.

When I met Kyle back in June, he was a very wary young boy. His nervousness wasn’t really about other dogs. He absolutely loved them. It was people he was unsure about. He was happy to have humans around but wasn’t particularly engaged with us and was quite nervous.

What I loved about Kyle was how he was with the other dogs. He was friendly, gentle and happy in their company and you could see there was a really lovely dog underneath that uncertainty.

I knew he needed some one-to-one time to build his trust and confidence, and that was very difficult to give him in a kennel environment with so many other dogs needing attention.

So, nearly three weeks ago, Mr Kyle came home with us.

As I expected, he was very nervous at first. In fact, even around the other dogs he initially kept himself to himself. For the first 36 hours, we simply gave him space and let him work things out for himself.

And he did. He very quickly realised that he was safe, nobody was going to hurt him and life here was actually pretty good.

Watching this beautiful dog evolve, exactly as I hoped he would, has been such a lovely thing to see.

Fast forward three weeks and look at Kyle now.

He is walking off lead with the other dogs and has been on several pack walks with dogs he had never met before, where he was absolutely lovely.

When he meets new dogs, he is usually the cautious one, but he always wants to be friends. He reads other dogs really well too. If another dog isn’t particularly friendly, or one of ours isn’t interested in playing, Kyle takes the hint and leaves them alone.

He really does love other dogs and is very affectionate with them. His play can get a little enthusiastic with Jackson, but he isn’t constantly on the go and he is very respectful of the older dogs who aren’t interested in playing. He simply ignores them.

Other dogs are a very important part of Kyle’s world.

When Kyle first arrived, he was terrified of the car. He would visibly shake.

Now he knows the car means adventures and walks. He isn’t quite at the stage of hopping straight in, but he will climb in himself and settle down next to another dog. The shaking has stopped completely.

He’s still a little nervous, but he has made massive progress and has never been car sick. I’m sure this will continue to improve as he learns that getting in the car means something good is going to happen.

If I’m working at my laptop, he will usually be somewhere in the same room, and if we’re watching TV, he’ll happily settle in the lounge with us. But he is also perfectly happy to wander off into the garden or another room and find himself a sofa to sleep on.

He will come over for a fuss, lean into you while you rub his chest or ears and sometimes gently give you a little kiss. He trusts me now and has become very affectionate, and whether we are out walking or at home, he will come running when I call him.

We’ve also been introducing Kyle to more of the big wide world.

He’s been to a café, a pub garden and a garden centre, and he has done incredibly well.

At the café, he settled down quietly and simply took everything in. He seemed to really enjoy the pub garden, and the garden centre was a much bigger challenge as it was busy and there was a lot going on.

The only thing he found difficult were the different floor textures, which he found quite scary.

Interestingly, he was exactly the same when he first arrived from Spain and encountered the different flooring in our house, and now he doesn’t give it a second thought.

That’s Kyle. He learns. He watches. He works things out. And his confidence grows.

The videos below will hopefully give you a little glimpse of how far this lovely boy has come.

Kyle is a young, clever dog and he is adapting incredibly quickly. He is very easy to live with and, after his walks, he is quite happy to settle down and snooze.

He is completely house trained and has had no accidents since the day he arrived.

He sleeps in the utility room with Jackson and they are both quiet and settled until morning.

And although Kyle looks very much like a Collie, I wouldn’t describe him as your typical high-energy, high-drive Collie.

He’s actually a pretty chilled young dog.

I think he would be perfectly capable of doing things like agility in the future and I suspect he would be an easy dog to train, but I don’t think he is going to be the dog flying around the agility course like a rocket! He is much more steady and sensible.

He needs a young enough, friendly dog who will enjoy playing with him and become his friend. I don’t think Kyle would cope particularly well as an only dog because he gets a great deal of confidence from other dogs and is very closely bonded with them.

Because he is still shy and a little cautious about some aspects of life, we are looking for an adult, quieter home for him.

His new family should ideally enjoy countryside walks and be able to give him two good walks a day, while continuing to gently expose him to new experiences and help his confidence keep growing.

We would like his new family to have experience of rescue dogs and understand that sometimes you don’t need to push a nervous dog. You simply give them time, space and the opportunity to discover that the world isn’t such a scary place after all.

Kyle has already shown us just how quickly he can blossom when given that chance.

He is a lovely dog with a lovely temperament. He is gentle with people, wonderful with other dogs and there isn’t a nasty bone in him.

He has gone from a nervous young stray in Spain to a dog who is walking off lead, enjoying pack walks, visiting cafés and garden centres, travelling in the car, playing with his friends, sleeping peacefully in the house and coming over to his foster mum for cuddles.

Somewhere out there is the family who is going to look at Kyle and think, “That’s our boy.”

And when they find him, they are going to be very lucky indeed to call him theirs.

This is him climbing in the Van now big steps for a dog who was so scared that first week

He gets his foster sister Lucy to look after him in the car

name: Jackson
description:
Jackson is a 7 month old male Lurcher Cross who has now been in the UK for nearly three weeks, so we can give you a really good picture of what life is like living with this lovely boy and, importantly, how he has settled into life here.

Jackson started his life as a stray in Spain and came into the rescue we have worked alongside for the past 15 years when he was a young puppy.

I travel to Spain twice a year with my own dogs and, because of the relationship we have built with the rescue over many years, I only bring dogs back to the UK that I have personally met and spent time with and would be happy to have living in my own home or one of our foster homes.

When I met Jackson in June, I believed he was probably a Galgo, a Spanish Greyhound, but he may well be a mix, possibly with Labrador.

One thing I did know was that he was going to grow into a big boy and that he was far too special to spend his puppyhood growing up in Spanish kennels.

He was a lovely, friendly puppy who wasn’t particularly nervous. I took him out to a café and to the vets while I was in Spain and he simply accepted everything that was happening around him. New places, new people, other dogs, nothing seemed to faze him.

And having now lived with him here, we can see that this really is Jackson.

Jackson currently lives with five other dogs, including his great friend Kyle, who also came over from Spain.

For such a young dog, he has been remarkably easy and uncomplicated.

Like he was in Spain, Jackson adjusts to new situations incredibly quickly. He is lovely with the other dogs and, importantly, he is respectful. Not every dog wants to play with a seven-month-old whirlwind!

He and Kyle absolutely love playing together and sometimes they get a little bit over the top, but you only have to tell them and they stop.

And then you will often find them cuddled up together asleep.

Jackson also looks for Kyle when they are out walking if Kyle has wandered off somewhere sniffing, so it is very obvious that he forms lovely bonds with other dogs.

Because of this, we really don’t think it would do Jackson justice to be an only dog. He genuinely enjoys canine company and we would like to see him living with another friendly dog.

Obviously, anyone who knows Sighthounds will know that recall isn’t necessarily their strongest attribute! But so far, so good with Jackson.

He has met lots of other dogs and has walked in a pack alongside friends’ dogs, including three small Terrier types, and he has had no issues at all.

If Jackson gets a little too playful and another dog tells him off, he is respectful and listens.

He absolutely loves his countryside walks and has recently discovered the wonderful art of blackberry picking!

We have some lovely videos below of him doing exactly that, happily wandering along with a whole pack of dogs.

He walks nicely on the lead, although he is a strong young dog and occasionally forgets himself and needs reminding that we are supposed to be walking nicely! Mostly, though, he is very good.

We have deliberately taken Jackson to lots of different places to see how he copes with life outside the home.

He has been to coffee shops, a garden centre and a pub, always accompanied by other dogs, and he has taken everything completely in his stride.

He is a very friendly boy and will happily say hello to anyone who wants to say hello to him.

At the garden centre, he absolutely loved the ladies and was rolling around on his back amongst the clothes rails, thoroughly enjoying himself!

He has met children who were the right height to receive Jackson kisses too.

At the pub, we sat in the garden and Jackson simply lay down and watched the world go by.

The same at the café, just completely relaxed and taking everything in.

At home, Jackson is actually a pretty chilled boy.

He is a typical Sighthound in that once he has had his walk, he is very happy to crash out and relax.

He sleeps at night in the utility room in his own bed alongside Kyle and there are no problems at all.

He is also happy to jump into the van, although sometimes he does get a little car sick. It is still early days and he is getting used to travelling, so we expect this to improve as he becomes more accustomed to it. Most of the time, he is absolutely fine.

Jackson is looking for someone who is looking for a large, friendly, happy young dog and understands that, although he is wonderfully balanced, he is still only seven months old.

He will need someone who has the time and patience to continue his puppy training and help him grow into the lovely adult dog we know he is going to become.

He is affectionate, friendly, sociable, adaptable and incredibly loving. He has already experienced so much in his short life and has taken every new challenge in his stride.

We have included videos below showing Jackson in different situations, out walking with a pack of dogs, blackberry picking, visiting places, meeting people and simply being Jackson, because sometimes seeing a dog for yourself tells you far more than we ever can in words.

Jackson is not neutered as he is still too young and has plenty of growing to do.

He is fully vaccinated and has had all his required blood tests, which were clear.

Please don’t apply if you are looking for a quiet little sofa dog. Jackson is a young, active boy who needs a home prepared to give him the life, exercise, company and continued training he deserves.

But if you are looking for a big, beautiful, friendly, slightly ridiculous, loving young dog who is going to make you smile every single day, Jackson could be your boy.

Got really bored shopping and just laid down

Meeting Uncle Steve for the first time jumped on his lap

name: Polo
description:
Currently in Spain, transport available to the UK.

Polo is a medium English Setter, 10 years old.

Polo is a very handsome English setter who was found wandering the streets alone by a young woman. He was taken to one of the shelters we work very closely with and arrived looking very sorry for himself.

He was very thin and had wounds on his skin which have thankfully all healed up now and he’s looking much better!

Polo is the ideal dog for many families. He’s a setter with balanced energy levels since he’s a little older so while he still loves his walks, he equally loves his nap times too!

He’s a gentle and affectionate boy who loves people, although he can be a little bit shy at first until he gets to know you, but once he does, he is very loving.

He’s great with other dogs at the shelter and could live on his own in his new home or with another dog in the household.

Polo has a really wonderful nature despite his rocky past. We now know he belonged to a hunter who kept him chained up in his warehouse. Thankfully he now has the chance of a wonderful new life.

Polo has not been cat tested but can be for the right home.

name: Chicu
description:
Chicu is a large Griffon cross, 1 year old.

Chicu is a very handsome griffon cross, given up by his hunter like most of our dogs.

Chicu is a large boy with an atheletic build. He’s very affectionate with people and adores to be around them.

He comes running when he hears his name at the shelter too, although this will be different on an exciting walk, of course!

Chicu’s ideal home would be as an only dog or with female dogs, as males can worry him a bit at the moment.

We are hoping this will improve in time but he is most comfortable around females at the moment.

Chicu has not been cat tested but can be for the right home.

Currently in Spain, transport available to the UK.

name: Rubia
description:
Rubia is a beautiful Sabueso, given away because she was not wanted by her a hunter. She is a very active and energetic dog, as you would expect for her breed.

She shares a kennel with another hound who she gets on very well with. They love running around outside together and live happily side by side.

She has a cheerful and playful character and is very affectionate with people.

When she first arrived at the shelter she was very anxious around food, but she is improving with time.

A new home should let her eat by herself in peace while she learns food is plentiful and she will never need to go hungry again.

Rubia can live with older children and can be cat tested for the right home.

name: Zoey
description:
Zoey is a super-friendly, sweet, affectionate cross-breed puppy girl aged just 4 months old. She has a soft, short, black and white coat, and in some of the photos you can see her with her sister Rumi, who has the same temperament and sweet nature.

They are good all rounders and love other dogs and can be tested for cats. They will both grow to be medium to larger dogs.

Zoey is a wonderful girl, who just adores people. She loves to cuddle and has such a trusting and very nice nature towards people and other dogs, so super social and positive, loves the whole world.

Zoey loves the open space in the shelter to run around and have zoomies. She is a fun baby and we are looking for a family with another friendly dog or she can be on her own if her family are working at home, and children over 9 years.

name: Rumi
description:
Rumi is a super-friendly, sweet and affectionate cross-breed puppy girl aged just 4 months old.

She has a soft, short, black, tan, and white coat, and in some of the photos you can see her with her sister Zoey who is slightly shorter, and has the same temperament and sweet nature.

They are good all rounders and love other dogs and can be tested for cats. They will both grow to be medium to larger dogs.

Rumi is a wonderful girl who just adores people. She loves to cuddle and has such a trusting and very nice nature towards people and other dogs, so super social and positive, loves the whole world.

Rumi also loves the open space in the shelter to run around and have zoomies. She is a fun baby and we are looking for a family with another friendly dog or she can be on her own if her family are working at home, and children over 9 years.

Loves to socialise, gets on very well with all dogs, loves `people, has a happy, friendly manner about her, gentle and laid back.

name: George
description:
Handsome George is a super-friendly, 2 year old, Staffordshire Bull Terrier lad, with an attractive, black and white coat. He is a wonderful all rounder and friendly with dogs, cats, and children over 10 due to his size.

He just adores people as most Staffies do. He loves to sidle up to you and just cuddle and enjoys the stimulation of play. Apparently he has lived short term with a cat – we are waiting on a video to publish.

Poor George was found wandering and this couple with a cat took him in short term to get him off the streets and into safety but sadly they couldn’t keep him.

George walks very well on a lead, knows some commands and ready for his new home and he stands at 46ms.A home with another dog, or no other dog is what we want for him, that can be with or without cats and older children he would love.

Loves to socialise, gets on well with other dogs, loves `people, has a happy, friendly manner about him, lived with cats.

name: Nea
description:
Beautiful Nea is an 8 year old female Podenco located in Cornwall, a tan and white, medium-sized, rough coated Podenco lady who is very sweet and calm. Nea is a happy girl, full of beans with a very excited goofy ‘smile’ for you when you get home.

She loves to run, swim and chase a ball. Very cuddly with her humans (especially first thing in the morning) and adores a belly rub. She walks nicely in her harness and enjoys swimming in rivers and the sea.

She is perfect in the home but poor Nea is looking for a change of owner because due to her uncertainly and lack of confidence, her female owner is unable to handle her properly once she meets other dogs on her walks.

Despite walking perfectly on her lead in quiet areas, she feels threatened by other dogs and so reacts. A trainer or a experienced owner used to this would be able to work with Nea and help her feel less threastened when meeting other dogs.

Maybe also a less busy environment where Nea can get her less stressful and more remote walks.

Nea hasn’t lived with young children before, but she has a nice nature with her family so we think children over 14 years.

Nea has lived with another dog in the past (and reactive dogs out are able to live happily with their own pack in a home) but it may be easier to say only dog home. Nea has lived with cats

Loves to cuddle and share love with her family, has a happy, friendly manner about her. Very cute and pretty.

Good with dogs: Only dogGood with cats: YesGood with kids: over 14 years onlyGood with people: YesLocation Cornwall

name: Greyson
description:
Greyson is an eight month old cross-breed pup who will grow to be around medium sized. Greyson fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Greyson was found on the side of a road in Romania with his brother. They were feeding from the corpse of a deceased dog as there was no other food source around. Sadly Greysons brother later died of parvo after they were rescued.

Despite this horrific start in life Greyson has arrived in the UK and is quite a character. Just a cheeky little chap on the look out for his next bout of fun. He mixes well with other dogs and would like another dog in his forever home.

He is a little wary of strangers but once he connects with you he will be your very best friend. Greyson wants to play with the safe rescue cat and can live with respectful children aged ten plus.

name: Tamsin
description:
Our extra special girl Tamsin is approximately two years old and the most beautiful mixed breed with something of a hound appearance.

Tamsin weighs a delightful thirteen kilos and measures fifteen inches from shoulder to paw. Having been found abandoned on the streets, Tamsin has been in our Cyprus shelter for three months.

Our shelter manager reports that Tamsin has the sweetest and calm personality, and she thoroughly enjoys walking on the lead where her behaviour is exemplary.

Tamsin has a wonderful personality and exudes kindness and empathy. She thoroughly enjoys her time with her human companions and shares happiness and affection.

Tamsin is absolutely beautiful with her rich tan and black coat, puppy dog eyes, striking ears and a near perpetual smile. Film star quality looks to say the very least. Tamsin is the ideal adoption candidate who is ready made for a kind and loving family.

Tamsin enjoys her time in the car and seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats, kittens, children and donkeys.

name: Georgia
description:
Our extra special girl Georgia is approximately two years old and almost certainly a pointer or thereabouts. Georgia weighs sixteen kilos and measures seventeen inches from shoulder to paw.

Having been found abandoned on the streets, Georgia has been in our Cyprus shelter for just three months.

Our shelter manager describes Georgia as wonderfully well behaved and with perfect manners. She has a gentle and affable disposition and thoroughly enjoys human interaction.

Her appearance is quite stunning with a rich chocolate coat with a white chest beautifully enhanced by an array of freckles. Georgia always secures admiring glances from her very extensive fan club in the shelter.

Having certainly been preloved and well cared for Georgia is the perfect candidate for a very fortunate adopting family. She will blossom in her new home and return love and affection in oodles.

Georgia walks really nicely on her lead and enjoys her time in the car. She seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Angela
description:
Meet Angela — a true angel of a dog, and what’s in a name!

Angela is a 8 year old Grand Basset Griffon Vendéen.

After spending some time in a shelter, we took Angela under our wing, and she is now safely staying with one of our regular foster families in Spain.

She has settled in beautifully and is ready to find her forever home. Angela gets along very well with all the other dogs at her foster home and also tolerates cats.

She is now ready to travel, so if Angela is the dog you have been waiting for, please don’t wait too long.

Angela is approximately 8 years old, with an estimated date of birth of 1 June 2018 according to the shelter veterinarian. She is a female Grand Basset Griffon Vendéen, possibly a mix, standing approximately 46 cm tall and weighing around 18 kg.

She is house-trained, gets along well with other dogs and can live with cats. She cannot currently be tested with small children, although Griffons are generally known to interact well with children, so this would need to be considered on an individual basis.

Angela has tested negative for five Mediterranean diseases and brucellosis. She is microchipped, has an EU pet passport, is spayed, fully vaccinated and her parasite treatments are up to date.

Her new home must have a secure, fenced garden with fencing appropriate for her size, so please allow for a height of around 150 cm.

Angela has already been through enough and now deserves a loving, safe and permanent home where she can enjoy the rest of her life surrounded by people who will cherish her.

Could you be the person who gives this very special girl the happy ending she deserves?

name: Dorris
description:
Dorris is a 5 year old female American Bulldog Cross with a loving and playful nature who has sadly been waiting in rescue for over 2 years.

In the home, Dorris is calm, clean, and well behaved. She is non-destructive and enjoys a quiet, settled environment where she can relax, play with her toys, and spend time with her person.

She is affectionate and enjoys both playtime and cuddles, forming a strong bond with those she trusts.

Dorris is a fun and engaging dog who brings personality and joy into the home. She is happy to entertain herself with toys or chews but equally enjoys interaction and affection from her humans.

Dorris does struggle around other dogs and will need to be the only pet in the home. Walks and environments need to be carefully managed to ensure she feels safe and comfortable.

Due to her needs, Dorris requires an experienced and understanding owner who can provide structure, calm handling, and appropriate management of her environment.

Kennel life can be particularly stressful for Dorris due to the presence of other dogs, and she is often kept in a quieter area to help reduce this stress.

Dorris would suit a calm, structured home where she can feel safe and settled. She needs an owner who will advocate for her, manage her surroundings, and allow her to live a peaceful life without unnecessary pressure.

When given the right environment, Dorris is a loving, loyal, and joyful companion who simply wants to play, cuddle, and belong.

If they have been around children, what ages were the children?

How does the dog walk on the lead?She does focus on other dogs and will lunge at them, so will need to be walked in quieter areas or exercised in a secure field on her own. When she’s on her own, she’s generally well behaved on the lead, no excessive pulling. She’s quite nosy and likes a good sniff around.

How long can the dog be left at home without issue?7 hours plus. She was left for longer periods when I had to stay at work and was absolutely fine when I got home. No destruction or accidents. My neighbour did say she barked a bit when left, so she may be sorted to shorter periods or a house without many neighbours.

Is the dog destructive at home?Not at all, she is extremely well behaved girl in the house. Fully housetrained and doesn’t chew anything she shouldn’t. She was provided with a variety of chew toys though as she constantly likes to chew or play with balls etc.

Whats are they fed?I fed her raw and she loved it

name: Serena
description:
*** SERENA WILL COME TO FOSTER IN BANSTEAD, SURREY, ON 1ST NOVEMBER 2026 ***

Our extra special girl Serena is approximately two years old and a medium sized cross breed perhaps with something of a hound content.

Serena weighs thirteen kilos and measures ten inches from shoulder to paw. Having been found abandoned on the streets, Serena has been in our Cyprus shelter for around four months.

Our shelter manager describes Serena as very sweet and she has an exceptionally loving personality. Serena enjoys amazing eye contact with her favourite human and constantly wins numerous hearts.

Her sandy coat is beautifully enhanced with a white flash to her chest along with four white toe tips. Her ears are gorgeous and probably award winning, leaving Serena as visually stunning.

Serena is the ideal adoption candidate and will make a perfect addition to her forever family. She is so deserving.

Serena enjoys her time in the car and walks nicely on her lead. She also seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Brisbane
description:
Brisbane is a young, large crossbreed aged just over 3 year old with a gentle and affectionate nature.

Brisbane is a loving and people-focused dog who forms strong bonds with his humans. He enjoys being close and will happily follow you from room to room, always wanting to be near his people.

Brisbane is a double merle and has some sensory impairments, including limited vision in one eye and reduced hearing. Despite this, he navigates his environment well and lives a happy, full life.

In the home, Brisbane is calm, clean, and well behaved. He is non-destructive, settles well, and can be left alone without issue. He adapts well to everyday life and has shown he can cope in busier environments such as shops and cafés when supported correctly.

Brisbane is dog friendly and has shown he can live alongside other dogs. He is also gentle with children, although due to his sensitivity, a home with older or dog-savvy children would be more suitable.

Brisbane can become overwhelmed in new or busy situations. When this happens, he may become overexcited and struggle to regulate himself. This is not aggression, but a response to feeling unsure, and with calm handling and structure, he settles well.

He walks nicely on the lead and responds well to guidance. With consistency and a calm approach, he continues to grow in confidence.

Brisbane would suit a patient and understanding home that can provide structure, routine, and a calm environment. He needs owners who are willing to manage introductions carefully and allow him time to decompress and feel secure.

Brisbane is a gentle, loyal dog who, in the right home, will form a deeply devoted bond and become a constant companion.

Brisbane is crate trained, clean, and quiet in his crate overnight. He is not destructive at home but does need access to chew toys to keep himself entertained.

He especially enjoys filled Kongs, raw bones, and a game of tug. While he can struggle to self-settle at times, he’s learning the concept of “quiet time” and developing an off switch.

He enjoys accompanying his foster carer to work and confidently navigates busy public spaces such as shops and town centres. Brisbane is calm in loud environments and loves interacting with people. He can be left alone without issue, often just sleeping or chewing his toys.

As a Double Merle, Brisbane comes with some genetic considerations. He can both see and hear, although his left eye, which has a starburst pupil, may have some visual limitations.

Due to his lack of pigmentation, he is sensitive to the sun and can burn easily, so he requires sun protection and careful management.

description:

name: Cindy
description:
We don’t have any previous history on Cindy due to her coming into our care as a stray. Although we soon learnt that she is super sweet and absolutely loves all the attention. Cindy has been very affectionate with everyone and loves meeting new people. She does have a cheeky and giddy side as well, that likes to come out, meaning she does enjoy playing and running around.

Cindy’s family must be willing and aware that she will need grooming every so often to keep her fur maintained.

Since being in our care, she has enjoyed being in the company of other dogs and gets all excited and wants to play. We do believe she could potentially live with another dog of a similar temperament – subject to a successful meet.

We do believe she could potentially live with children no younger than 5 years old, this would be subject to a successful meet.

It is unknown how Cindy would be living with cats or other small animals.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Swan
description:
Swan came into our care as a stray, meaning we don’t have any previous history on her. She is a very friendly and affection girl, who loves nothing more than a good cuddle with you. As Swan is still young, she would be best suited to an active home able to give her the regular exercise that she requires. Swan thoroughly enjoys playing in our enclosed area where she loves playing and chasing tennis balls.

At times Swan can be a little boisterous and fully on when she gets all excited to see you. We believe she would be best suited to a home with children no younger than 16 years old – subject to a successful meet.

During her time with us, Swan has shown to a social towards other dogs, although at times can be a little over the top and vocal, which is typical of her breed. We do think she could potentially live with another dog of a similar temperament – subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Malinois Puppies
description:
This beautiful littler of puppies were born on site, when their Mum sadly came into our care pregnant as a stray.

We are looking for experience families for our lovely litter of Malinois puppies. It is advised to either have knowledge or experience of owning this breed or a similar breed. Active homes are needed for each of our puppies.

New owners must be willing to take to puppy classes and continue socialising, as this is vital for this particular breed. They will need mental as well as physical stimulation, there new family must be willing to provide this.

They may potentially live with another dog of a similar temperament and willing to put up with a young pup – subject to a successful meet.

We believe they could potentially live with children no younger than 10 years old – subject to a successful meet.

Please do not phone up regarding these puppies – as all the information is provided above.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3 months.

name: Cleveland
description:
Meet Cleveland!  At around 32kg, Cleveland is a big lad who is still very much a puppy at heart.  He is boisterous, lively and full of enthusiasm, and he absolutely loves people and getting attention.  He can be a little too enthusiastic at times and will often jump up when greeting people, so his new adopter will need to be prepared for a large, bouncy youngster who hasn’t quite realised just how big he is!  Cleveland is a typical 10 month old puppy – fun, energetic, affectionate and still learning about the world.  He will need plenty of exercise, mental stimulation and, most importantly, a family who is committed to continuing training and helping him mature into the lovely adult dog we know he can become.  We feel Cleveland would be best suited to an active family with experience of large, boisterous dogs, who understand that training a young large breed dog takes time, patience and consistency.  He is looking for a home that will continue his basic training and work on his manners.  Help him learn that four paws on the floor is the best way to get attention, Give him clear, consistent boundaries.  Be patient while he grows from a bouncy puppy into a well-mannered adult and understand that, although he may be 32kg, Cleveland still thinks he’s a tiny puppy!  He will need a private secure garden.

Cleveland has socialised well with other dogs whilst in our care, although he is very bouncy and playful with them.  We do feel he could be rehomed with another energetic dog of similar size following a successful meet and greet (must be neutered).

As Cleveland came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on him so would prefer any children in the home to be 16+ years.

name: Poppy
description:
Meet Poppy!  She is looking for an active and loving forever home.  Poppy can be a little nervous when she first meets you, but once she gets to know you, her lovely, friendly personality really shines through.  She absolutely loves lots of fuss and of course tasty treats!  This is a very energetic and bouncy young girl who will need a home that can keep up with her.  An active family who enjoys plenty of walks, outdoor adventures and playtime would be ideal.  Breed experience would be an advantage, particularly for someone who understands the energy and needs of Husky type dogs.  Poppy loves running around our compound with her toys and will happily drop it for you to throw again.  She also has a funny, playful side – she likes playing in her water bowl and will happily spend time splashing about in it. Like any young dog, Poppy is still learning and will need continued patience, training and guidance.  She does know lots of commands, which is a fantastic starting point, although she can be strong on the lead and will need someone confident and capable of helping her improve her lead manners.  Poppy is also still working on her house training and does occasionally use her bed as a toilet, so her new adopter will need to be prepared to continue working with her patiently and positively.  Despite these little quirks, Poppy is a lovely, affectionate and fun-loving girl with so much potential.  She will need a private secure garden.

Poppy has socialised well with other dogs whilst in our care and is very giddy and playful with them, so we feel following a successful meet and greet she could be rehomed with another dog of similar size and energy levels (must be neutered).

As Poppy came into the home as a stray, we have no previous history on her so would prefer any children in the home to be 12+ years.

name: Hugo
description:
Hugo was found as a stray so we don’t have any background information about him. He has been a happy boy from the moment he arrived and loves all of the staff here. He is an extremely excitable and energetic boy with a big personality! He can be quite a handful pulling on his lead when he is out and about on walks, so will need a family that has the time and patience to help him work on his basic obedience and lead training. He will need an active home that can provide plenty of exercise, mental stimulation and enrichment to give him ways to express his enthusiasm. Hugo loves being off lead in our enclosed compound area zooming around and playing with toys.

He is taller than either of the breeds typically are, making him more of a medium sized dog. This should be taken into consideration before applying.

Hugo has interacted well with staff whilst in our care but due to his energy levels we believe it would be best for Hugo to be rehomed to an adult only home.

Hugo has interacted well with dogs whilst in our care so we believe that he could potentially be rehomed with another dog of a similar size and temperament – Subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3  months.

name: Hope
description:
This lovely girl is a happy, excitable greyhound who is full of love. She is always pleased to see you and will happily jump up to greet you when you go in to see her – she just can’t wait to say hello! She absolutely loves attention and giving out kisses to everyone she meets. Hope gets excited for walks but isn’t overly giddy and can walk nicely on a lead after a short time. Hope came into our care as a stray, but we know that she was previously from the racing background, so we are unsure what she is going to be like living in a home environment. Hope is in need of a stable and loving home where she can finally settle in and become part of the family.

Hope loves other dogs and has recently been paired, showing that she does enjoy having a canine companion. She would benefit from a home where she can continue having positive experiences with other dogs. Hope can be rehomed with another dog – subject to a successful meet.

Hope can be rehomed with mature children who are 14 years and over – Subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3  months.

name: Tia
description:
Tia has come straight from racing kennels so has never lived in a home before. She is always very excited and happy to see both staff and volunteers. She certainly isn’t shy when it comes to showing her affection – she absolutely loves giving out kisses! She isn’t fussed about being handled or groomed and just loves the attention. Tia get excited when it’s time for a walk so can pull a little on the lead initially but with some training and consistency, this is something that can be worked on easily.  Tia is ready to find her forever home where she can enjoy the next chapter of her life, with plenty of love, cuddles and adventures.

Tia can be rehomed with children who are 14+ year and over – Subject to a successful meet.

Tia is currently paired with another greyhound and interacted well with them whilst in our care, we believe that she can be rehomed with another dog – Subject to a successful meet.

Please do not apply for a dog if you have a holiday within the next 3  months.

name: Blue
description:
Blue is a sweet and affectionate boy who has already shown just how lovely he can be with staff and volunteers here. On walks he enjoys being close to you and will happily lean into your side for a fuss. He is quite calm on a lead for an ex racing greyhound. As he has come straight from the racing environment, he will need some time to adjust to life outside of the kennels and will benefit from gentle, positive training and confidence building as he discovers new experiences in life. This lovely boy has all of the potential to become a wonderful and devoted companion.
